Witnesses described it not as arrows flying, but as a relentless downpour sweeping across the skies.
To his fellow companions, he would use his bowstring as a lute,
Playing a solemn dirge that only heroes could appreciate.
But he never truly learned from the memories he shouldered.
As his arrows pointed skyward towards Aquila, his fate was already sealed.
The final arrow pierced through heaven and earth, yet it ultimately met its demise in shatters.

2103019.name: Warring Scholar
2103019.description: When any ally target Breaks any enemy target's Weakness, Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and regenerates Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy. After defeating any enemy target, regenerates Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy.
2103019.shortDesc: When Breaking enemy targets' Weakness, Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" and regenerates Energy. After any enemy target is defeated, regenerates Energy.
2103019.lore:
Metitalus, a dual emblem of pride and shame for us Nodists.
He is our pride, for this scholar has golden blood in his veins.
His ingenious ideas continue to inspire successors across generations, centuries after his time.
In his skilled hands, raw iron and ropes were transformed into walking machines.
Due to his contributions, engineering textbooks doubled in size.
He is also a shame as he did not use his creations to benefit society
And chose instead to engage in the Chrysos War.
The wisdom of Cerces forged the lethal spears of Nikador,
Destroying countless city-states to ruins with his inventions.
Ultimately, he and his creations were both consumed by flames.
Now, only by deciphering those cryptic, intricate manuscripts
Can one catch a glimpse of his astonishing talent and unyielding ambition.

2103020.name: Forbidden Knowledge's Martyr
2103020.description: When any ally target uses their Ultimate, consumes HP from all ally targets equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their current HP and increases their DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s), lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2103020.shortDesc: When using Ultimate, all allies consume HP and increases their DMG dealt.
2103020.lore:
Do you know that there's a group of unrecognized scholars beyond the Grove of Epiphany?
They don't care about the inheritance of established knowledge.
Instead, they focus solely on the mysterious, unexplored realms.
They regard the pursuit of knowledge as an arduous odyssey,
Where they brave thorny paths and precariously walk tightropes.
At every step, they endure immense suffering, and one misstep could spell their destruction.
Whether it's unraveling the mystery of the golden blood, probing into the existence of the Titans,
Or even the dreaded black tide,
Became a direction in their pursuit of knowledge.
Such blasphemous endeavors will surely invite divine punishment and suffering.
Nearly all scholars meet their untimely ends as soon as they make slight progress in their research,
Either being hunted down by Titan followers or dying in bizarre accidents.
Yet they continue to plunge toward those eternally unsolvable answers, like moths drawn to the flame.

2103021.name: Erythrokeramism
2103021.description: After a memosprite uses an attack, Charge their memomaster's "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After the memomaster uses "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" to use their Ultimate, increases the memosprite's DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2103021.shortDesc: After a memosprite attacks, Charges their memomaster's "<u>Brain in a Vat.</u>" After a memomaster uses their Ultimate via "<u>Brain in a Vat,</u>" increases their memosprite's DMG.
2103021.lore:
Foolish apprentices, stop your faulty reflections.
Cerces sows wisdom in the hearts of mortals,
Yet you attempt to harvest its fruits in your minds.
Poor apprentices, put down your experimental tools.
The gods have bestowed upon us the five senses.
Why resort to external devices to discern the truth?
Other schools' theories and means will only teach you how to discover knowledge,
But Erythrokeramism will tell you that all knowledge already dwells within the depths of your memory,
Merely awaiting your touch to pick them up.
Discard all observation, extrapolation, and logic,
And instead sense, hear, and imagine with your heart.
Peel away the deceptive mask named materiality that shrouds the world,
And let all things return to their truest form.

2103022.name: Book-Weaving Divine Machine
2103022.description: When ally target enters "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, used Ultimate also deals "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>"'s True DMG, and increases "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>"'s attack count by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>. This effect triggers up to 1 time for each ally.
2103022.shortDesc: After ally targets enter "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, using Ultimate also deals "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" True DMG and increases "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" attack count.
2103022.lore:
Look! I've dug up a gear of the Book-Weaving Divine Machine.
My ancestors were fortunate enough to behold that magnificent machine.
Looming in the valley of the Pioli mountains,
It tirelessly copied knowledge for humanity, day in and day out.
Its towering bronze frame soared skyward,
Adorned with intricate gold threads.
Pages cascaded down like a waterfall,
Spreading the wisdom even to the remotest city-states.
If the divine machine willed it, the books it produced could cover the earth.
Alas,
This shared treasure of all city-states was ruined by greed.
Kings and lords all coveted it, even just a fragment.
This mere gear is a piece of its shattered limb, torn apart by humanity.

2103023.name: Memory Seed Cultivator
2103023.description: The True DMG multiplier of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier and increases attack count by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. After a memosprite uses an attack, they can trigger the True DMG of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" and consume its attack count.
2103023.shortDesc: Increases the True DMG dealt by "<u>Butterfly Soul.</u>" Memosprites' attacks will additionally apply True DMG from "<u>Butterfly Soul.</u>"
2103023.lore:
Welcome to my seed greenhouse, honored first visitor.
As you can see, there's no soil or seedlings here.
Those mundane tasks are left to the followers of Georios.
My role is to nurture the seeds of memories, ensuring their regular and orderly growth.
Look at that pink one — it's the dream of a young girl becoming a dancer.
Born into a political dynasty, her fate seemed sealed, far from the stage's embrace.
Yet, within my incubator, she's dancing gracefully.
One day, the girl will come here to collect her memory.
Trust me. They'll be more vivid than her real-life experiences.
Look at the blue one — it holds the dream of an adventurer.
The golden one embodies the dream of a general...
As for those gray ones, they're mere remnants of failed experiments.

2103024.name: Orphan Carehouse
2103024.description: After breaking an enemy target's Weakness, recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Points. Using Basic ATK and Skills to attack enemy targets inflicts <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> additional Toughness Reduction and applies <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "<u>Harmonize</u>" stacks.
2103024.shortDesc: When Breaking enemy targets' Weakness, recovers Skill Points. Using Basic ATKs and Skill to attack enemy targets can cause additional Toughness Reduction and apply "<u>Harmonize</u>."
2103024.lore:
We deeply mourn the loss of Headmistress Cynthia,
Who passed away peacefully in her dream three nights ago.
It's truly heartwarming to see that all the children returned from all corners of the world to pay their respects.
Those war orphans,
Are now craftsmen, scholars, and artists.
The story begins on the day the orphanage was founded.
Amidst the war-torn chaos when blood and fire burned,
Headmistress Cynthia brought love and beauty back to this world.
She built a home on the island of Doria,
Warmly taking in, like a mother, every child forsaken by the gods.
With bread and goat's milk, she filled their hungry bellies.
With poetry and sports, she replaced killing,
Shaping them into healthy and proud individuals.
Today, Headmistress Cynthia has transformed into a golden butterfly, ascending to the heavens
Or, more fittingly, soaring into our hearts,
Igniting our passion to build even more havens of hope.

2104001.name: Flame-Chase Alliance
2104001.description: When enemy targets take Break DMG, they additionally take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of "<u>Harmonize</u>" max limit, and charge all allies with "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of their respective Max HP. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn by enemy targets.
2104001.shortDesc: When any enemy target takes Break DMG, they additionally take "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG and charge "<u>Blazar</u>" for all allies.
2104001.lore:
You call those flame-chasing marauders heroes? Ridiculous.
They're nothing but zealots blindly following a deranged Empress, who indulges her fantasies under the guise of saving the world.
A horde of power-hungry, glory-obsessed lunatics, they only add fuel to the fire.
Has tearing the wings from the Chrysalis of Gold brought even a touch of beauty to this ugly world?
How many lives were consumed by the cracked earth after they took the Coreflame from the Pillar of Stone?
The calamity wrought by their flame-chasing is a disgrace greater than the Chrysos War.
Even the sins of Nikador and Zagreus pale in comparison to theirs.
Helioticus, how did you lose that eye of yours?
And what about my daughter — And the fathers, mothers, and children of everyone in this city?
How dare you sing praises for those who have not returned!

2104002.name: Lazy Fingerjoint
2104002.description: When an ally target breaks an enemy target's Weakness, afflict them with <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Harmonize</u>." After attacking Weakness Broken enemy targets, causes any DoT currently applied on it and "<u>Harmonize</u>" to immediately deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
2104002.shortDesc: When Breaking enemy Weakness, afflict it with "<u>Harmonize</u>." After attacking Weakness Broken enemy targets, causes any DoT currently applied on it and "<u>Harmonize</u>" to immediately deal 1 instance of DMG.
2104002.lore:
Even one as knowledgeable as you have likely never been to the decayed land of Cassacco.
There, people lie bedridden year-round, their fingers being the only agile part of their bodies.
With a finger's curl, fruit rolls through open windows to their bedsides.
A quick clap summons honey brews brought by a Thief's Hand.
Fruits are stolen from orchards up the mountain.
Honey brews are pilfered from neighbors' cellars.
A mystical well, said to bear Zagreus' blessing, never runs dry,
Pouring forth nectar and wheat in endless supply.
It's a grandiose lie so outlandish that even the boldest liar wouldn't dare to tell.
How blissful! You steal from me, I seize from you.
Life is effortless, never requiring one to step outside.
Cassacco has rotted through countless days and nights. There, even death
Requires no more than the snap of a finger.

2104003.name: Elegy Priest
2104003.description: "Flower of Annihilation" appears in the Action Order: Records "<u>Blazar</u>" obtained by allies. When it takes action, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the recorded value plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u> to all enemy targets, then clears the record. Increases its SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for each "<u>Obsession</u>" stack that allies possess. When any ally target enters combat or is downed, or when any memosprite is summoned or disappears, Charges "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP for all ally targets.
2104003.shortDesc: Flower of Annihilation appears in the Action Order. During its action, deals DMG to all enemies based on "<u>Blazar</u>" and "<u>Obsession</u>." When any ally target enters combat/is summoned/is defeated, charges "<u>Blazar</u>" for the team.
2104003.lore:
Would you believe it, passing friends?
Just now, I witnessed the demise of millennia.
Travelers singing dirges plucked a star from their clothes
And planted a fragment of time in the soil as if sowing a seed.
I saw the ruins of Styxia, kissed by the River of Souls.
I saw Loukas consumed in a sea of flames.
The fire devoured everything in its path.
These events, once real and long past, were recorded by the travelers
And brought back before our eyes.
I asked them why they came?
The travelers revealed that they were plucking broken memories.
This city has long been annihilated.
As for us, we are merely souls under Oronyx's Miracle,
The final elegy of farewell.

2104004.name: Oathkeeper
2104004.description: After turn <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> (counted as the cumulative number of turns taken by all allies) ends, action advances the first character in the current team and their memosprite by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. For the next <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s), grant them an extra turn at the end of the turn. After using an attack in this extra turn, deals Additional DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the attacker's Max HP to the attacked target. Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" allies possess increases this DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier.
2104004.shortDesc: For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> allied turns, advances the action of the first character in the current team and their memosprite, the character gains an extra turn, and attacking deals DMG based on the number of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
2104004.lore:
Hush, the Oathkeepers of Talanton are coming.
May you have lived your life with integrity and never broken an oath,
Be it a deal with a workshop, an alliance with a neighboring land,
A promise to the Titans, or a miracle prayed for in a temple.
The believers of Talanton are everywhere. They are the wind,
The shadows, and the shattered stone tablets.
They defend all contracts of the world on behalf of the Titans.
With daggers, they slay kings who betray allies.
With an eagle's beak, they punish gamblers who deceive the Titans.
With a rose, they wounded even the cunning Zagreus.
Some claim the Oathkeepers are merely the priests' lies,
But that is because one cannot see them until one dies.
No matter how much you evade, they will always be waiting for you at the end.

2104005.name: Growth-Ring Carver
2104005.description: When enemy targets become afflicted with Freeze or DoT status, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> base chance to Blast this effect to adjacent units. These effects are Blasted back to the original unit when no adjacent units are present. The same effect can only be Blasted 1 time per target per action. When one enemy target has Blasted effects a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> times or when defeated, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u> to that target and adjacent targets. Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" allies possess increases this DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2104005.shortDesc: When an enemy is afflicted with Freeze or any DoT state, they have a chance to Blast the debuff to adjacent targets. When a debuff has been Blasted multiple times or when the target is defeated, deals DMG to the target and adjacent targets based on the number of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
2104005.lore:
I understand you detest the conduct of the Engravers, but please allow me to plead on their behalf.
Heroes set out with lofty aspirations, only to return to a world of desolation.
They witnessed friends consumed by tsunamis and monsters piercing the chests of their kin.
In their hearts, all that remains is helplessness and despair.
Trees record history through their rings, while Engravers etch the past out of empathy and aspiration.
In their stories, aging heroes never embarked on their expeditions.
Lost friends either returned or were merely on a long journey.
The collapsed city still stood, sheltering bewildered elders
And children speaking the language of their homeland.
Through lies, they craft a fleeting dream for heroes trapped in the past.
Absurd as it may seem, it is indispensable for this era.

2104006.name: Whispering Woods
2104006.description: After ally targets use Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, "<u>Murmur</u>" deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG multiplier to adjacent targets. DMG dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>" then additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> every time an Ultimate is used.
2104006.shortDesc: After ally targets use Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, "<u>Murmur</u>" dealts DMG to adjacent targets. Then, DMG dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>" increases for every time an Ultimate is used.
2104006.lore:
Please listen to our story. A story about the last scholars of Vitus.
Do not mock us for our cowardice, for before we fled, we too raised our weapons.
But our mentor fell in a pool of blood over a scroll.
Our brothers perished defending the city gates, their bodies never found.
Don't look at us that way. It happened even before the black tide came.
What's the difference? The black tide, the conflicts, and the city-states of the Era Chrysea.
Extinct civilizations took stories with them, but knowledge endures.
We swallowed the whispered words of Cerces.
Our bones transformed into trees, our flesh into new leaves.
The wisdom once nurtured by Vitus all bore fruit on our branches.
Pick this seed and let it sprout somewhere far away.
A thousand years from now, scholars will still uncover the proofs we have left behind.

2104007.name: Sky Priest
2104007.description: After ally targets are attacked, gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> "Lightning Sacrifice(s)." After they unleash a Counter, gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> "Lightning Sacrifice(s)." When they have <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Lightning Sacrifice(s)," "Lightning Sacrifice" is cleared to increase Ultimate DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s) and deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG to all enemy targets. This damage is considered as Ultimate DMG.
2104007.shortDesc: After being attacked or having launched a Counter, gains "Lightning Sacrifice." When possessing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Lightning Sacrifices," removes all "Lightning Sacrifice" and increases DMG dealt by Ultimate, as well as dealing Ultimate DMG to all enemies based on "<u>Blazar</u>."
2104007.lore:
I am still searching for their traces. The traces of the subjects of gods, who, blessed by the Eye of Twilight,
Once dwelt high in the sky.
Mythical winged beasts wielding swords forged with wisdom surpassing that of mortals
And from thunder.
Warriors born of Aquila's blessings,
Who dedicated their all to the Titans in the divine war.
Their valor matched only by the Kremnoans blessed by Nikador.
But why have they vanished like the silent black tide?
Did the incarnation of the day thunder not once pierce the sky?
Without her heroic feats, who would dare raise the banner to slay gods?
Or were they, too, cursed by the Titans, just as we are,
Punished for daring to draw swords against the gods?

2104008.name: Conflict Author
2104008.description: When the total HP lost by ally targets is equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP or after recovering from being downed, deals "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP to all enemies. When a character's turn starts, consumes HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP, increasing this value by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> after every time this effect is triggered. When ally characters become downed for the first time in this battle, restore their current HP to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP, and HP will no longer be consumed when their turn starts.
2104008.shortDesc: When accumulating a certain amount of lost HP or recovering from being downed, deals "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG to all enemies based on their Max HP. Characters can resist fatal damage, and consume their HP at the start of every turn before this effect is triggered.
2104008.lore:
I would rather call Antiparus a playwright than a general,
For he turned the entire war into his own drama.
The people of Talanton, united with the soldiers of Georios,
Were cast as the villains.
The supporting Ladonians, arriving too late for the climax,
Reluctantly took on the role of chorus.
His legion, guided by the spear bestowed by the king,
Dedicated themselves to a meticulously crafted three-act play at his command.
The sounds of battle became a grand symphony, etching fear and anger onto the actors' faces.
Chariots collided, ranks clashed, like lions locked in a ferocious duel.
All the while, he savored the spectacle, taking his first step out of the military tent.

2104009.name: Wounds of Plenty
2104009.description: "Maddening Voice" appears in the Action Order: After any ally target launches a Follow-Up ATK, advances their action by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When taking action, advances the action of the first character in the current team by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>. After that unit uses an attack, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> instances(s) of "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the ally target's ATK, and up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> instances of attacks can take effect. Moreover, all ally targets' "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG dealt multiplier increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier, and a countdown with <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> SPD will appear in the Action Order. Effects will last until the countdown's turn begins.
2104009.shortDesc: "Maddening Voice" appears on the Action Order: After any ally target launches a Follow-Up ATK, advance the attacker's action. When the attacker takes action, action advances the first character in the current team, and deals multiple instances of "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG after they use an attack. Increases all allies' "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG.
2104009.lore:
You came too late. The blade of revenge has already carved out the heart of this king.
He strummed the melody of the sea, leaving the guards intoxicated in the wind.
The maidservants dreamed of boundless riches and indulged themselves in the game of scarf competition.
Even though I clutched my sword as I slept, I could not resist the frenzy in my heart.
He appeared before me just like this, with a crowd of revelers following behind.
The jesters clinked their goblets, as if celebrating my execution.
I offered no resistance and drank the honey brew he gifted me.
How I wished it had been a cup of poison, so I would not have to feel
The cold blade as it claimed my life.
Alas, the dirge played for me was utterly dull,
Far less enchanting than the melodies Lady Hysilens played before the expedition began.

2104010.name: Tearless Garden
2104010.description: After ally targets launch a Follow-Up ATK, ignore Weakness Type to additionally reduce <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> Toughness. When ally targets Break enemy target Weakness, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> ATK to all enemy targets. Every point of Max Toughness the enemy target has increases this DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier.
2104010.shortDesc: After an ally unit performs a Follow-Up ATK, ignores Weakness Type to additionally reduce Toughness. When any ally target Breaks Weakness, deals "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG to all enemies based on their Max Toughness.
2104010.lore:
That's right, I'm the one tending this garden,
A utopia where only carefree people can settle, a place where no one sheds tears.
An isolated haven where the black tide and wars are thrown behind.
Why dwell on disasters a hundred years from now? Why fret over the troubles of future generations?
We conventionally forget everything about Amphoreus.
We sow seeds after a sound sleep,
And when weary, we find a stone to sit on and chat.
The remaining blessing of the Gate of Infinity protects its ramparts.
And as long as people remain attached to this land, it will not fall.
You say this is self-deception? But worry changes nothing.
So why not make the most of our good years, shed our last tears,
And gather by the bonfire to enjoy life's endless banquet?

2104011.name: Beastkin
2104011.description: When no enemy targets on field have "Beast Tongue," "Beast Tongue" is applied to random attacked target after ally targets use an attack. After enemies with "Beast Tongue" receive a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> attack(s) or are defeated, they take Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u>, adjacent targets take DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u>, and all allies increase CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> and SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). If in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, then it is considered to additionally launching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> attack(s).
2104011.shortDesc: After attacking, applies "Beast Tongue" on random attacked targets: When attacked <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> times or defeated, deals DMG to the target and adjacent enemies and increases all allies' CRIT DMG and SPD. While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, this is considered as additionally launching attacks.
2104011.lore:
You surely have never witnessed how the offspring of Clydamas avenged him.
The warrior, blessed by the sky father, was strangled by their brother upon returning home.
The nightingale heard the breath of Thanatos first,
The ten-horned beast sniffed out the murderer, and the dromas mourned its nurturer.
They recall the youth once standing on a mountain, raising an eagle to the sky,
Summoning a pride of lions on a plain, and carrying forward the heroes.
The taste of blood lingered on the tip of the direwolf's tongue,
Given by him as they fell into the trap together.
Surely you have heard of the hunter who never killed his prey.
His arrows flew only toward enemies that harmed the world.
The beasts raised by the youth still guard the homeland from afar.
Beneath the forest lie the corpses of the unrighteous.

2104012.name: Gray River's Representative
2104012.description: After every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" obtained by all allies or after defeating any enemy target, fires <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Lux Arrow(s) to attack random enemy targets. Each Lux Arrow deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u>. Each Lux Arrow will cause "<u>Murmur</u>" to deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG, and cause "<u>Murmur</u>" to gain Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the total sum of ally characters' ATK.
2104012.shortDesc: After defeating any enemy target or gaining every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> <u>Critical Boost</u>" stacks, fires a Lux Arrow to attack random enemy targets. The Lux Arrow charges "<u>Murmur</u>" and triggers "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG.
2104012.lore:
Have a drink, one-eyed fellow.
My last client bore a striking resemblance to you.
That one looted a neighboring village,
Emptied their money bags, and left severed heads in return.
And the red-haired noble, he humiliated a young man,
Comparing him to an animal lower than a rat.
There's surely a berth reserved for him on the longship of the Hand of Shadow.
As long as you're willing to pay the price,
I can slowly hang the unforgivable villain with a rope
Or use a short sword to fell a great hero.
My predecessors used to say this trade
Is like swimming in the river of the Hand of Shadow.
Terrifying, isn't it? But if it's not in these bleak times,
Who would want to do this accursed job?

2104013.name: Caprism
2104013.description: After all allies use their Ultimates a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s), deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> instances of Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u> to a random enemy target. This DMG will deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG to adjacent units. Every time this effect is triggered, increases the number of instances by 1 in this battle and increases the Basic ATK / Skill / Ultimate DMG dealt by ally targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>, to a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
2104013.shortDesc: Whenever allies have used Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, deals DMG to a random enemy target and adjacent enemies. Every time this effect is triggered, increases its instance of DMG by 1 and increases the Basic ATK / Skill / Ultimate DMG dealt by ally targets.
2104013.lore:
Don't ruuuun! Helioticus? Perfect timing.
Don't just stand there. Help me catch that chimera!
It was obedient before, but ever since it tasted a snack from the Lotophagists,
It's been restless.
Watch out for its claws. It may look small,
Its claws are sharper than a Ladon spear.
Oh, and I forgot to warn you, its tail has a trace amount of toxin.
If it stings you, starting from the wound, your leg might go numb for a few days.
I've put a lot of effort into raising this little rascal.
When I was guarding by the tree, I recited the name of Cerces a thousand times.
Given my success in cultivating such a creature, I think the Grove suits me better than the battlefield.
Hey! Didn't you want me to say something? Why are you leaving?

2104014.name: Theater Puppet Maker
2104014.description: After the team uses a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Ultimate(s) while not under the Overclock effect, gains Overclock: After attacking with an Ultimate, deals <u>Aftertaste</u> DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the attacker's ATK <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). After using an Ultimate, this status will end. The character in position 1 in the current team activates their Ultimate, Charges <u>Brain in a Vat</u> to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, and uses Ultimate <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> times before the status ends on them.
2104014.shortDesc: Whenever allies have used Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, enters the "Overclock" state. While in this state and after an Ultimate is used to attack, deals "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG, and the first character in the current team activates their Ultimate and charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2104014.lore:
Do you come to watch the performance? What a shame, the puppeteer has already gone far.
The man had one arm assembled from wood and steel, with the upper arm
Still bearing scars upon scars.
He carried a divine jar that turned muddy water into clear springs
And a wooden bird that hovered in midair, allowing him to travel by flight.
Most impressive of all were the puppets that accompanied him,
One clad in a long robe, the other wielding a sword,
Claiming to be a court magician and a knight.
He repaired broken waterwheels and musical instruments, healed the ailments of the elderly,
Yet never accept a single coin.
He sat among the audience with us, though his gaze never fell on the puppets,
Only on the children laughing uproariously, until he departed on his wooden bird.

2104015.name: Home of Odes
2104015.description: The Charge required for "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, all ally targets' actions advance by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> and the DMG multiplier of the True DMG dealt by "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier, additionally increasing by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" possessed by all allies.
2104015.shortDesc: Increases the Charge required for the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, advances all allies' actions and increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>."
2104015.lore:
It's a pity that I cannot accompany you, my friend.
We are about to eradicate that detestable group,
A deranged cult that preys on children.
They give each of the children a poem
That glorifies a "past" entwined with inhuman torture.
The child named Corinchi was forced to strangle a venomous snake at the age of three,
While Dekamos played the harp until their pinky snapped.
To fulfill the delusions of the Mad One,
How many youths have been deprived of their lives,
Never becoming Corinchi, only to drown in despair?
And how many are on their way to becoming them,
Until they fall from the peak of Mount Tilkoya?
Even as we speak, the wicked rituals continue,
All to recreate the legends of heroes with the same tragic past.

2104016.name: Cocoon Dressmaker
2104016.description: When entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, inflict "Cocoon" to all enemy targets. They cannot take action in the next turn, are action delayed by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> at the start of the turn, and take Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base DMG</u>. While allies are in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, enemy targets will become afflicted with "Cocoon" again every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s), and "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> attack count(s) after the first time enemy targets become Weakness Broken.
2104016.shortDesc: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, enemy targets will become unable to act and take DMG every several turns. Recovers the attack counts for "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" after Breaking an enemy's Weakness.
2104016.lore:
Have you ever seen a garmentmaker of butterfly wings? Ever since the fall of Mnestia,
They have become rare to find.
Not all beings are as fortunate as the Mountain Dwellers,
Born with Kephale as their template.
The siren of Phagousa, the wondrous beast of Aquila,
And countless creations and Titankins yearning for rebirth,
Had once received the guidance of the Gilded One.
Just like Mnestia,
They were wrapped within cocoons of golden threads,
And later, their souls were woven into humanoid forms.
The reasons are always frivolous, either love for a mortal
Or the desire to duel a hero in the arena.
Yet war ultimately destroyed it all. Unable to betray its creator,
My beloved shed its shell at dawn and fluttered those enchanting wings.

2105001.name: Time's Miracle
2105001.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Remembrance, dealing Ice DMG to all enemy targets with a high chance of Freezing them for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). After being attacked by memosprite while under this Freeze effect, additionally take True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP. Every time the enemy target is afflicted with this Freeze state, this DMG can be triggered a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
2105001.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Ice DMG to all enemies with a high chance of Freezing them. After being attacked by a memosprite while under this Freeze state, additionally take True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
2105001.lore:
This is an ancient remembrance inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Oronyx, the Veil of Evernight.
Born before the Chrysos War,
The great hero Corinchi set out on a grand journey for the throne.
He drank with gods in the sea and wrestled with their creations,
Ascended the sacred mountain under the guidance of priests,
And slew the black-fanged monster born from the nightmares of the earth.
Having won all the honors a hero could ask for,
He returned to his homeland, only to look down upon ruins.
How sorrowful it was! If only his life stopped the moment before he crossed the mountains.
If only he could have perished in his most glorious moment! The hero prayed to the gods.
The starry night's song swept over the mountain peak, stirring the passage of time,
Halting his steps in that final moment, and crystallizing him into a star in the sky.

2105002.name: Death's Miracle
2105002.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Nihility. Inflicts Burn, Shock, Bleed, and 2 stacks of Wind Shear to all enemy targets, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). After being attacked by a character, the aforementioned DoTs immediately deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
2105002.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, inflicts Burn, Shock, Bleed, and Wind Shear on all enemies. After receiving a character's attack, the inflicted DoTs can be triggered.
2105002.lore:
This is a nihilistic past inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the trace of Thanatos, the Hand of Shadow.
No one had ever truly seen Thanatos.
All descriptions of them were either fabrications or fragments of dreams.
Poets claimed that souls were the foundation of all things.
They were carried to the farthest reaches of the west wind, transforming into fine rain that descended towards the afterlife.
Thus, with life came death, and in between, the unchanging souls flowed.
But since the black tide swept across the land, death had long eclipsed life.
The souls wandering along the banks of the River of Souls had lost their destinations,
With fewer and fewer of them returning to this world.
Emptiness bred deceit, and death nurtured fear.
Had Thanatos, too, been corroded by the black tide? Had they been driven mad and no longer ferried souls?
Or, as the most pessimistic fools feared,
Had the god of death long perished in silence?

2105003.name: Strife's Miracle
2105003.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of The Hunt, dealing Wind DMG to all enemy targets and advances all allies' actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, with the Max Energy being <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
2105003.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Wind DMG to all enemies and advances all allies' actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, with the Max Energy being <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
2105003.lore:
This is an instance of the hunt inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Nikador, the Lance of Fury.
Countless witnesses had beheld the conqueror's heroic bearing as they fought in the sky.
Lightning swept across their shoulders, and the winged Titankin gnawed at their arms.
The fearless God of Strife spared no time to wipe away the golden blood.
In response, a hundred lances pierced through the dark clouds.
Wounded, the many-eyed giant bird of the sky dome shrieked and fled.
The Father of Victory traversed mountains and valleys
To relentlessly hunt the arrogant foe that usurped the sky.
Across Amphoreus, from north to south,
Lances like inverted raindrops pierced the sky, illuminating the night.
Thunder spears roared eternally as they struck the earth.
Imitating the divine, the sky priests and the warriors of Kremnos clashed head-on.
This hunt would never cease until one side was utterly annihilated.

2105004.name: Sky's Miracle
2105004.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Destruction, dealing Fire DMG to all enemy targets, consumes all allies' HP until <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>, and increases all ally targets' Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the start of the turn, restore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the acting unit's consumed HP, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2105004.shortDesc: Upon triggering Boundary Equation, deals Fire DMG to all enemies, reduces all allies' HP, increases all allies' Max HP, restores all allies' HP at the beginning of the turn.
2105004.lore:
This is a moment of destruction inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Aquila, the Eye of Twilight.
In ancient times, a wise king once built a vessel to traverse the sky.
Arrogant politicians promised the people that they would challenge the authority of the Titans.
Ridiculous jesters eulogized the tyrant, declaring that the eternal sovereign would reign over the sky.
They vowed to surpass Okhema, ascend through layers of clouds,
Tread the city of the sky priests underfoot, and even break the sky to rise above the blazing sun.
People sang of the tyrant's greatness, as they hauled wood, wove hides,
And forged roaring machinery to draw and support the flying steel behemoth.
How magnificent! Bearing the pride and arrogance of an entire nation, it sailed in the direction of the realm of the gods.
How laughable! Flesh and steel were obliterated in the thunder, in the blink of an eye.

2105005.name: Trickery's Miracle
2105005.description: Can consume <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Elation, dealing Follow-Up ATK DMG of a random Type to all enemy targets for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> – <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). All allies' Basic ATK / Skill / Ultimate DMG is considered as Follow-Up ATK DMG for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2105005.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals a random number of instances of Follow-Up ATK DMG of a random Type to all enemies and causes all allies' Basic ATK/Skill/Ultimate DMG to be considered as Follow-Up ATK DMG.
2105005.lore:
This is a fleeting elation inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Zagreus, the Coin of Whimsy.
Avsha, a land of truth and integrity,
Knew no thieves or gamblers, no flowery words or cunning speeches.
There, you could find all the virtues humanity has to offer,
Until the whispers of Zagreus chiseled a faint crack within.
"I can create truth with lies and weave lies from truth."
The disguised outlander swapped tattered rags draped in silk for gold,
And turned honey brew into muddy soup in plain view of all.
Yet no punishment could touch them, for they had never lied.
And so, the first liar of Avsha was born.
To avoid deception, mortals began scheming against one another.
Amidst the laughter of the gods, the former land of integrity became rife with lies.

2105006.name: Romance's Miracle
2105006.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use this ability and trigger Boundary Resonance with the Path of Propagation. Causes one designated ally to immediately take action and recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s). Gains the "<u>Levitation</u>" effect. When any enemy unit is defeated by a character with "<u>Levitation</u>," Boundary Equation regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> Energy, with the Max Energy set at <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
2105006.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, causes one designated ally to immediately take action, recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s), and gains "<u>Levitation</u>." When any enemy unit is defeated by a character that has "<u>Levitation</u>," Boundary Equation regenerates Energy, with the Max Energy set at <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
2105006.lore:
This is a tale of love and propagation inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Mnestia, the Chrysalis of Gold.
The god of beauty and love was so fragile that
Even a torrential rain could break their wings.
The Titankins, bearing the creator's image, hide beneath leaves, weeping.
They prayed to the gods for blessings.
"Born for such torment, why should we bother to flap our wings again?"
Hearing their prayers, the Chrysalis of Gold scattered their shimmering scale dust,
Covering the wings of the Titankins and granting them hundreds and thousands of offspring.
Their bodies grew heavy with the dust, and their lives shortened.
Bees and butterflies danced among flowers, only to age and die in a moment.
Yet hatched from eggs, their offspring continued the endless dance.
Oh, fragile butterfly! Life is short, why not dance to another tune?

2105007.name: Reason's Miracle
2105007.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Erudition. Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all enemy targets. Additionally, links the enemy with the highest Max HP with other enemies, inflicting "<u>Central Link</u>" on all enemies, and regenerating Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy to all allies.
2105007.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies and inflicts the "<u>Central Link</u>" effect on them, regenerating Energy for all allies.
2105007.lore:
This is an erudite utterance inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Cerces, the Bough of Rift.
A girl from Idilia was born with wisdom far surpassing that of ordinary people.
She solved all the puzzles left over a century.
With no questions left to challenge her, she found the sacred tree of Cerces.
In her arrogance, she prayed to Cerces for a question,
Believing even the Titans could not stump her.
She claimed to have exhausted all knowledge of the world, and wished to prove,
That she was wiser even than the gods.
Cerces asked, "What lies beyond Amphoreus?"
Bewildered, the girl stood motionless for three days and nights, unable to answer.
What, indeed, was the answer to the question?
The god smiled and swayed their branches, for they too did not know.
Admitting their own ignorance was what made them wiser than the girl.

2105008.name: Passage's Miracle
2105008.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Harmony, dealing Quantum DMG to all enemy targets and Break their Weaknesses at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Break Effect. When Weakness is Broken, triggers all Weakness Break effects from all Types.
2105008.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Quantum DMG to all enemy targets and Breaks their Weakness. Breaking Weakness triggers Weakness Break effects of all Types.
2105008.lore:
This is a harmonious celebration inscribed on a stone tablet. This is the miracle of Janus, the Gate of Infinity.
In an era before the calamity spread,
A grand festival was being held in Janusopolis.
The god unraveled the threads of destiny, weaving a common intersection for all travelers.
Forests that used to trap walkers were no longer hard to navigate. Paths that were blocked by rocks were now clear.
All the roads leading to the sacred land opened wide.
Janus lightly touched each doorway again, bestowing blessings
And guiding the pilgrims stepping through them to the shared destination.
The priests inaugurated the banquet with their chants.
Adventurers who had roamed the earth raised their goblets in a toast.
Messengers and kings from all city-states gathered together to celebrate the start of a new year.
Cast aside worries and disputes! Sing the same prayer in unison!

2202001.name: Radiant Jellyfish
2202001.description: Ally targets' Basic ATK DMG and Skill DMG ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the enemy target's DEF. This effect increases to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> on enemy targets in the Weakness Broken state.
2202001.shortDesc: Basic ATK DMG and Skill DMG dealt ignore a certain percentage of the enemy target's DEF. This effect additionally increases on Weakness Broken enemy targets.
2202001.lore:
Ever seen the ocean glitter? That's the Radiant Jellyfish throwing an eternal rave.
More than stars in the sky, horizon-to-horizon,
they are not afraid of humankind, even daring swimmers to join their luminous waltz.
Whispers claim they're Phagousa's kins.
As the ocean was far too dark at night,
they lit the way home for the drunken Phagousa.
Others insist they belong to Mnestia.
Golden butterflies fluttered into the ocean and transformed into jellyfish,
for their wings could not take flight in the sea.
Or perhaps they answer to no Titan,
simply dancing, propagating, and partying through millennia, from ancient past to the endless future.

2202002.name: Send-Off Carnival
2202002.description: For every type of debuff an enemy target is afflicted with, the Follow-Up ATK DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2202002.shortDesc: Enemy targets with more debuffs take more Follow-Up ATK DMG.
2202002.lore:
Been to a Megnakken send-off?
You can't find that western little city on maps anymore.
I still remember, the people would dress the deceased in the finest clothing,
paint the most intricate makeup on corpses, and adorn caskets with fresh flowers and fragrances.
The circus performs in full swing on stage and close friends laugh heartily in the audience,
their grief measured in decibels.
This rave continues for three days and nights. As the performance reaches its climax, the corpse is cremated in flames.
Everyone would sing and dance around the pyre as a final farewell.
This tradition stems is rooted in their unique religion,
for they believe that Thanatos is but Zagreus in disguise.

2202003.name: War Scribes
2202003.description: Ally targets' Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When entering battle or summoning memosprite, charges "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of each unit's Max HP. Then, when the next turn begins, "<u>Blazar</u>" is not depleted.
2202003.shortDesc: Increases Max HP. When entering battle or summoning memosprite, charges "<u>Blazar</u>." Then, when the first turn begins, "<u>Blazar</u>" is not depleted.
2202003.lore:
In Castrum Kremnos where military might is prized above all, there is a unique group of scholars —
they wield pens instead of swords, but still receive high respect from the Kremnoans. They are the war scribes.
They lay foot on every blood-soaked battlefield where the chariots have been,
carrying scrolls that merely repeat "victory" and "overwhelming victory".
Not because they value brevity,
but because they would waste no time or parchment on easy victories.
They enjoy every disadvantageous battle, carving lessons from cadaverous failures and analyzing lessons learned.
And when their enemies finally kneel, they casually scribble "Overwhelming Victory" again.
The Grove of Epiphany refuses to acknowledge them as scholars, for they only serve wars.
The scribes couldn't care less, for they much prefer to call themselves warriors.

2202004.name: Black Tide's Decrepit Bow
2202004.description: Ally targets' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After all allies end a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turns, causes the DMG dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>" to increase by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2202004.shortDesc: Increases ATK. After a certain number of allies' turns have passed, increases damage dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>."
2202004.lore:
I reclaimed half my life from that wretched black tide, but lost another half of it.
Let my warning save yours: Beware the Decrepit Bow.
It was once a proud kin of Strife, but its golden blood has been corrupted.
With cursed arrows in hand, it slaughters every living being in sight.
The withering bow shrieks as it fires arrows that never miss.
Comrades died there and then, and I've been wounded too.
As I escaped from the abomination, black blood trickled from my wound.
This wound will never heal, and shall devour my life.
I know not how much longer I have to live, as I await heaven's will.
Perhaps that shot of arrow had already carved the ending in destiny.

2202005.name: Joyspring Fount
2202005.description: Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" on the ally team increases Follow-Up ATK DMG and Additional DMG received by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. After enemy targets receive DMG from summons, this effect further increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for 1 turn.
2202005.shortDesc: The more stacks of "<u>Obsession</u>," the more Follow-Up ATK and Additional DMG enemy targets take. This effect further increases after enemy targets are attacked by summons.
2202005.lore:
Have a sip of the sweet spring water, for it is the Era Chrysea's legacy.
Beautiful ancient memories moisten your lips and vitalize your heart.
An era when joy grew thicker than dromas fur,
forcing humans to bury excess bliss in underground springs.
But who would have imagined that the black tide would come drowning humanity.
Only these waters stream on peacefully, year after year.
Now that the sealed history has been brought back to light accidentally, the golden liquid euphoria geysers,
drenching its surrounding in unparalleled ecstasy.
Sip lightly, however, and save your thirst.
There are darker days ahead, when you'll thirst for it again.

2202006.name: Nodist School
2202006.description: When ally characters use Ultimate to attack, CRIT DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and the attack ignores Weakness Types to additionally reduce <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Toughness.
2202006.shortDesc: Increases CRIT DMG when using Ultimate to attack, and additionally reduces Toughness regardless of Weakness Type.
2202006.lore:
You must've heard the Amphoreus' proverb, "all knotted on a single thread."
But what you might not know is that the Nodists invented it.
Those mathematicians buried in calculation drafts are supporters of the Great Unity philosophy.
After the careful calculations and extrapolations by the founder of Nodism,
they claim that the origin of all things is but a bunch of numbers,
and we're different from ants only because the order of our numbers is different.
Like knots on a thread, only our placements and how we're tied differ.
In line with this philosophy, we're akin to ants, and Titans are akin to us.
But I'm rather troubled. If the world is just a bunch of numbers,
why do those mathematicians still eat bread and drink honey?
They can simply eat their calculation drafts instead, no?

2203001.name: Memorial Chrysalis
2203001.description: For each stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" ally target has, ally target's Basic ATK and Skill DMG dealt increase by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When an ally character departs from the field, is knocked down, or when an ally memosprite disappears, the character in position 1 in the current team obtains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of that ally's "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks and an equal amount of "<u>Obsession</u>" max limit. This additional stack limit will disappear after <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2203001.shortDesc: Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" increases Basic ATK and Skill DMG. Upon leaving the field, the first character in the current team obtains a certain percentage of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
2203001.lore:
How do I know these tales? A secret for your ears—
the truth may sound ridiculous, but please believe my words.
I once adventured in distant woods and brought a giant golden chrysalis back with me,
its threads scattering daylight into an iridescent glow. An enchanting sight indeed.
Every third dawn, a prismatic butterfly emerges,
whirling around me as it flits in the air, unfolding visions of someone else's life before me.
I consulted one of Oronyx's priestesses, and she kept silent for a long while,
before stating that it was merely a miracle left behind by Era Chrysea.
I knew you'd give me that look.
If you're doubtful, just take this as my newly weaved story.

2203002.name: Madness Malady
2203002.description: When an ally target is hit with an attack or consumes HP while their HP percentage is less than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Obsession</u>" from the target with the highest "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks in the team, heals for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of this unit's Max HP, and increases DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). This effect can only be triggered <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per turn.
2203002.shortDesc: While HP percentage is less than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, consumes "<u>Obsession</u>" from the ally target with the highest "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks in the team to restore HP and increase DMG dealt.
2203002.lore:
Heard of the malady named heartless malaria?
It consumed the prosperous city of Radero and left it in shambles.
First, citizens were simply dazed, forgetting their way home,
doctors were clueless to the cause, and could only send their staff to care for the ill.
But this strange ailment started to spread like wildfire, its symptoms growing more severe
Parents forgot their children's faces. Chancellors drew blanks on their king's name.
That was until a roving medic found the cause — mosquitoes.
These mosquitoes did not feed on blood, but had a strong inclination for humankind's memories. 
But it was all too late. The people here were no more than the walking dead.
The great physician could only sigh and set the mosquitoes ablaze, reducing them to ash along with the entire city.

2203003.name: Giant Wise Tree
2203003.description: Ally targets' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using ATKs that deal Ultimate DMG, causes the "<u>Murmur</u>" on the attacked target to deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of original DMG.
2203003.shortDesc: Increases ATK. After using attacks to deal Ultimate DMG, triggers "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG.
2203003.lore:
Ever visited the southern pondering woods? It was once home to a sacred tree,
which possessed far more wisdom than humans, and had countless disciples kneeling at its roots.
It even dared to claim to be more knowledgeable than Cerces,
enraging the Grove of Epiphany. Yet the sages who came forth to debate were all defeated.
The sacred tree shook its lush leaves, oozing arrogance.
As the smartest being on land, it was certain it could even parse celestial equations.
Sturdy branches clawed at the heavens, leaving an endlessly long shadow upon the earth
till lightning cleaved it the moment it penetrated the highest rain clouds.
Now what remains of the forest is only embers and ashes.
If you wish for wisdom, seek its incinerated branches.

2203004.name: Performance Artist
2203004.description: For every time ally targets attack a Weakness Broken enemy target, this target takes 1 instance of "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the attack's ATK when it recovers from being Weakness Broken.
2203004.shortDesc: Every time a Weakness Broken enemy target is attacked, this target additionally takes "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG when they recover from being Weakness Broken.
2203004.lore:
Those lunatic performance artists are Amphoreus' greatest disgrace.
They galavant city-to-city to spread clownish manifestos.
Stophantones, their ringleader, is a third-rate comedy actor
who delusively believes that wars could be substituted with comedies, and won based on who earns the loudest laughters.
At Castrum Kremnos' arena festival, they quipped at their opponents,
only to be met with a fist. Curtains closed before the punchline.
In Ladon, their preposterous poses during their performances
were seen as an insult to the Eye of Twilight, and nearly had them tossed off the cliff.
But Stophantones blames failure on "poor comedic timing."
Well, in my opinion, their existence is quite a fine comedy.

2203005.name: Wolfmother of the North
2203005.description: Increases the CRIT DMG of ally targets' Basic ATK and Skill DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, for every instance of attack used by an ally target, they immediately obtain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Charge for "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" when they exit the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state. Charge gained this way cannot exceed <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2203005.shortDesc: Increases CRIT DMG dealt by Basic ATK/Skill. When attacking while in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, you can Charge "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" upon leaving the state.
2203005.lore:
Forget stories of a hero slaying a beast. I am going to tell you something else.
Meet Vostrozh — a female wolf who manipulates blizzards and snow in the north.
She suckled seven exiled human princes, taking them in as foster sons,
 and taught them her wisdom and cunning.
But their father was a tyrant who was paranoid that his sons would usurp the throne.
Thus, he had them exiled.
When soldiers came butchering, the she-wolf died shielding her seven human cubs.
The princes survived and, alongside their supporters, dethroned their father years later.
Yes — You may have guessed that they became the legendary Seven Kings of the North.
The moral of the story? Humans can be more bestial than beasts.

2203006.name: Orphaned Daggers
2203006.description: Increases "<u>Critical Boost</u>" max limit by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s). For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of total team Max HP lost by the entire team, the ally target acting next immediately receives 1 stack of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" at the start of the turn.
2203006.shortDesc: The maximum stack of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" increases. Every time the team loses a certain amount of HP, they gain "<u>Critical Boost</u>."
2203006.lore:
Some children are unfortunately born as tools for vengeance.
Orphaned Daggers, they're called. A name that breathes fear into everyone's hearts.
Poison vials for teething rings. Daggers for bedtime tales.
They inherited the skills of Amphoreus' finest assassins.
Taught until they were bought by schemers for dangerous and dirty work.
After all, what lord would fear an innocent child?
Utilizing this weakness, blades kissed necks like feathers.
When the guards came to their senses, they found two corpses,
one of which was the child themself, for this was why they had prepared the poison vial.
With their target perished, their existence no longer held any meaning.

2204001.name: Jolly Bandit
2204001.description: For every 1 consumed or overflowing Skill point of ally targets, obtain 1 prize draw chance, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). When entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, summons "Lottery Machine" and consumes all prize draw chances to obtain prizes, with a base draw of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). There is a small chance of obtaining the Special Prize, which deals 1 instance of DMG of a random Type equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> to all enemy targets and increases the "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG multiplier dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier. This effect can be stacked and lasts until the ally exits "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>". The Consolation Prize deals 1 instance of DMG of a random Type equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> to random enemy targets.
2204001.shortDesc: After consuming or Overflowing Skill Points, you can obtain a prize draw chance. When entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, draw for a prize. There is a chance of dealing DMG or increasing "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG dealt while in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state.
2204001.lore:
What audacity! To pilfer the crown before gawping crowds,
then deface the king's bald head with uproarious graffiti.
This is Worthinnis' Master Thief—
swiping treasures and bestowing jests.
Ostentatious nobles don prized jewelry in the city, just to anticipate their arrival,
but only attract third-rate copycats.
Now, this historic citadel teems with pickpockets and pranksters,
yet none pursue the true identity of the Master Thief.
Merchants? Detour far and wide.
But to those who seek mirth — enter! I will open the gates for you.

2204002.name: Winged Tiger
2204002.description: After ally targets use an attack, apply "Fearful Tremble" equal to their "<u>Critical Boost</u>" stack to an attacked target with the highest "Fearful Tremble" stacks. Every stack of "Fearful Tremble" reduces enemy targets' DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. When reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s), it deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> and loses <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s), then increases the enemy's CRIT DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). When the enemy target takes action, they obtain all "Fearful Tremble" on the field. When they are defeated, "Fearful Tremble" will be applied to the enemy target with the highest current stacks.
2204002.shortDesc: After using an attack, applies stacks of "Fearful Tremble" equal to "<u>Critical Boost</u>" stacks on enemy targets. This reduces enemy targets' DMG dealt, deals DMG to the target upon reaching a certain number of stacks, and increases the target's CRIT DMG taken.
2204002.lore:
Hold your steps, young hunter. Yonder woods aren't our hunting grounds.
In this forest of bones, predators become prey.
The one-armed tiger is last of its line after mankind's massacre.
It cheated death and won Cerces' gift: wings veined with wisdom.
Kremnoan soldiers armored by gold, bellowing songs of war,
Ladon's rangers, their arrows dripping with venom, chill beasts to marrow.
The tiger baits soldiers into bottomless pools, their golden armors sinking swiftly in the glacial waters.
It cloaks itself in fog to dodge arrows, snapping the rangers' throats with a single bite.
Hush! Footfalls crunch. The air reeks of vengeance.
Run! With all your might. The king of the forest begins its hunt.

2204003.name: Berserker
2204003.description: After any ally unit is attacked, it is considered as all ally targets have been attacked. All ally targets will Charge "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their respective Max HP.
2204003.shortDesc: After receiving an attack, it is considered as all ally targets having been attacked, and all ally targets will Charge their "<u>Blazar</u>."
2204003.lore:
Broken spears mark the end of an unjust war.
The fallen warrior — his invincible body was drained of all blood.
Did he recall galloping along the frontiers with his brothers as they shared their ideals?
Back then, he was a true warrior, the pride and joy of all Kremnoans.
Did he remember how he was unwilling to die with glory, even as he carried grievous wounds,
choosing instead to offer his ravaged flesh to the Mad King in exchange for the power to fight endlessly?
Blinded by blood, he was oblivious to his brethren's pointless deaths.
Manipulated by cruelty, his hands showed no mercy even to children.
His brother mercifully ended this series of mistakes—
as the berserker fell, his soul finally returned home.

2204004.name: Nether Longship
2204004.description: When enemy target receives "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG, "<u>Murmur</u>" stacks in possession obtains Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of this instance of DMG. This cannot exceed <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold "<u>Murmur</u>" Charges, the enemy target immediately takes 1 instance of Lightning DoT DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the "<u>Murmur</u>" clearance threshold. Each enemy target can trigger this up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> time(s), and the trigger count resets after any unit's action. This DMG is "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG and cannot defeat the enemy target.
2204004.shortDesc: When "<u>Blazar</u>" deals DMG, it will Charge "<u>Murmur</u>." Every time "<u>Murmur</u>" Charges by a certain percentage, triggers 1 extra instance of DMG.
2204004.lore:
Wayworn traveler, will you brave our longship?
This salt-crusted relic ferries all wayward souls home.
Hewn from Aidonia's unrotting withered trees,
sails tough beyond comparison, and even once received a certain Titan's blessing.
We once trailed Castrum Kremnos' warpath,
plucking refugees who had lost their homeland.
We've surfed the roaring waves of the black tide,
netting thousands of innocent lives from drowning depths.
Brace yourself — the longship stirs.
May Thanatos summon the winds from the nether realm, for we come seeking their audience.

2302001.name: Ichor Memosprite
2302001.description: When an ally target loses HP, gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Obsession</u>." This can trigger up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) and can be triggered again after any unit takes action.
2302001.shortDesc: When an ally target loses HP, gains "<u>Obsession</u>".
2302001.lore:
"Let those things that should not be remembered be destroyed."
With this belief, I rise from the amber-colored pool.
With murmurs of countless souls buzzing in my mind,
I witness every birth and death in this world.
My wings are taken from the harpy eagle, my fangs from the python.
Carrying all memories of humanity's nemeses, I embark on a journey to judge memories.
"Go on, leave nothing behind."
The girl opens her umbrella, showing me only her back.
So I gleefully tear open the neck of my next victim.

2302002.name: Wicker School
2302002.description: Increases enemy target's DoT by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After receiving Follow-Up ATK, gains "<u>Murmur</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold.
2302002.shortDesc: Increases enemy target's DoT. After receiving Follow-Up ATK, charges "<u>Murmur</u>".
2302002.lore:
This school of thought was never recognized by the Grove of Epiphany.
It all began on a whim, when someone in the holy city proposed the first formula:
"I don't want to move a muscle."
And so he spent an utterly ordinary day.
Then came the second day, and the third.
Each day he lay on the street, whether eating or sleeping.
When people asked about his reasons for doing so, he proposed the second formula:
"One should be like an empty basket, never carrying too much."
He kicked over an empty basket, and some praised his wisdom.
Gradually, the one person lying on the street became many,
spending their days chatting and basking in the sun, pursuing nothing else.
Until one day, without warning, they all dispersed in different directions.
When asked why they no longer chose to lie idle:
"A basket must carry something after all."
The founder replied with a smile.

2302003.name: Trickster Knight
2302003.description: Each stack of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" increases Follow-Up ATK DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When ally targets launch Follow-Up ATK, gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Critical Boost</u>."
2302003.shortDesc: The more "<u>Critical Boost</u>" stacks, the higher the Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt. When ally targets launch Follow-Up ATKs, gains "<u>Critical Boost</u>."
2302003.lore:
Warriors of Kremnos have always valued glory,
so sneaking and trickery are considered shameful, despicable acts.
Yet there was one soldier who never faced his enemies head-on.
He either set elaborate traps beforehand or struck from the gutters.
Some say he trained in Dolos, others claim he was Zagreus's spy.
But the battalion under his command always brought back news of victory.
A colleague, fed up with his ways, challenged him to a duel,
but he changed the terms to an archery contest,
with arrows aimed at oneself.
Terrified by this bold proposal, the challenger asked him to demonstrate first.
He calmly pulled the trigger.
The bolt grazed his cheek and embedded in the wall.
"Sorry, I missed."

2302004.name: Furiae Philosopher
2302004.description: When ally character's HP percentage drops below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for the first time in a single combat, activates Ultimate and allows this unit and memosprite's Ultimate DMG in this combat to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> DEF.
2302004.shortDesc: When ally target's HP percentage drops below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for the first time in a single combat, activates Ultimate and allows this unit and memosprite's Ultimate DMG in this combat to ignore a portion of enemy target's DEF.
2302004.lore:
I was born from an indigo stone, bearing the breath of flames.
Furnace and magma have malleated my form,
while glory and gunsmoke have draped me in battle garments.
My arms can crush throats,
and my stone tablets shatter skulls.
"The strong devour the weak. The victors write the history. These are the fundamental laws of our world."
I preach this doctrine to mortals,
urging them to lay down their hoes and take up weapons.
And I shall personally embody the truth of strife.
When Nikador raises his spear,
I will march with the army, raise iron hooves toward distant horizons,
and spread a madness that masquerades as philosophy.

2302005.name: Ruin Strider
2302005.description: Increases ally target's Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. For each ally target currently on the field, increases ally target's "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2302005.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' Max HP. For each ally target currently on the field, increases the "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG.
2302005.lore:
We are solitary wanderers, roaming through broken walls and fallen places.
The ruins are the stage where we play for fun, where frozen memories slip through our fingertips:
Bricks and soil, sword edges and pelts...
Sensory stimuli transform into stories, telling the end of every city-state.
We gather these stories, transmit and record them, then send them far away.
Sometimes at the Okhema market, sometimes in the hands of survivors.
Some call us opportunists, others call us grave robbers.
Facing these accusations, we simply laugh them off:
As long as those stories remain engraved in people's memory, civilization will never perish.

2302006.name: Bizarre Spell
2302006.description: Increases ally target's "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, after using Ultimate, gain "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
2302006.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG, and gains "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge after using Ultimate.
2302006.lore:
A tale circulates among poets:
A scholar unearthed a scroll of parchment from ruins,
upon which an ancient curse was inscribed.
It could kill anyone in this world,
but first, it would collect its price.
An ambitious rebel recited it,
hoping to curse the emperor to death.
The next day, when servants opened his door,
they found the corpse of the one who spoke the curse.
A beggar on the street recited it,
praying to punish the slave master's crimes.
*tinkle* *tinkle*
That villain dropped dead in an instant,
while the price was just three bronze coins in the bowl.
"Could this curse possess the magical power to judge right from wrong?"
The audience debated loudly, then shook their heads and sighed.
If such a curse truly existed,
why would there still be so much injustice on earth?

2303001.name: Legless Iron Pigeon
2303001.description: After any ally target attacks a Weakness Broken enemy target, converts the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>. For each stack of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" gained, this effect additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
2303001.shortDesc: After ally targets attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, deal <u>Super Break DMG</u>. The higher the number of "<u>Critical Boost</u>" stacks, the higher this <u>Super Break DMG</u> will be.
2303001.lore:
Before Aquila's Thousand Eyes were closed,
there was a kind of bird made of iron.
They were the creations of Skyfolk:
Forged in steel, yet no legs to stand on, they roam the skies for all eternity.
Born as the war machine, they were never allowed to touch the ground.
With these footless iron doves, the Skyfolk conquered the skies,
only to turn their spears against each other.
The iron doves were divided between the Blazing Sun and the Cloudy Rain,
charging and pecking at each other like mortal enemies,
falling from the sky like a rain of iron.
