Only when they touched the earth did these footless birds finally rest,
and for the first time, they caught the scent of green grass.

2303002.name: Leviathan of the East
2303002.description: Increases the "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG taken by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After enemy targets take DoT outside their turn, all allies receive "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their respective ATK. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> times per enemy target per turn.
2303002.shortDesc: Enemy targets take increased "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG. After enemy targets take DoT outside their turn, charge all allies with "<u>Blazar</u>".
2303002.lore:
No sailor has ever been untouched by the legend of the Kraken.
The beast lurks in the eastern depths, enormous, many-tentacled, dim-witted, and cruel.
It crushes passing ships with its tentacles, not even sparing the birds in the sky.
Some say it's Phagousa's malice incarnate, others claim it's kin to the sea sirens.
The only certainty is that this creature lacks a brain.
With a memory shorter than a fish's, it destroys everything in sight.
One day, the lord of Pearly Shores assembled a fleet.
Hunters set sail eastward, swearing to make the monster pay blood for blood.
But when the fleet arrived, the eastern seas were as calm as a mirror.
They found only the Kraken's corpse, sinking into the abyss alongside fish bones and debris.
It wasn't hunting that killed it, but self-destruction.

2303003.name: Stone Maze
2303003.description: When ally targets have <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Obsession</u>" or more, their Follow-Up ATK and Additional DMG increase by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After entering combat, when the number of ally targets on the field changes, grant <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Obsession</u>" to the ally target with the lowest number of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
2303003.shortDesc: When ally targets have a certain number of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks, their Follow-Up ATK and Additional DMG increase. After entering combat, when the number of ally targets on the field changes, gains "<u>Obsession</u>".
2303003.lore:
Have you seen the stone formation outside of Dolos City?
Row upon row, twisting and turning, like a labyrinth imprisoning the Minotaur.
If you wander in carelessly, it'll take you a whole day to find your way out.
But it wasn't created by any one person. At first, there was just a single strange stone.
A nameless traveler passed by and, on a whim, turned one stone into two.
Then some added more as a joke, others out of curiosity, and some even used it to write secret messages.
More and more people contributed to it, even demigods joined in the game.
So, lost traveler, hold your horses before getting angry.
Every stubborn stone blocking your path is a trick left by those who came before.

2303004.name: Note Thief
2303004.description: When an enemy target is attacked, if the "<u>Harmonize</u>" stacks exceed <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> and their HP percentage is below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, they additionally take True DMG equal to their current HP. This effect can only trigger once per enemy target. When triggered on Elite Enemies, all allies' "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Charge.
2303004.shortDesc: When an enemy target is attacked, if they have a certain number of "<u>Harmonize</u>" stacks and their HP percentage is below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, they are immediately defeated. If it's an Elite Enemy, all allies' "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" gains Charge.
2303004.lore:
"Classrooms shouldn't be the exclusive domain of scholars!"
In the Grove of Epiphany, a group of students had an ingenious idea.
They secretly printed lecture notes and brought materials outside the classroom.
What couldn't be printed, they copied by hand, distributing them for free,
benefiting the poor, orphans, and even illiterate elderly women.
When dusk fell, students and beneficiaries would gather together,
discussing what they'd learned that day, letting the branches of knowledge grow wild.
Bolder students even smuggled outsiders directly into classes,
disguising them as strange beasts, potted plants, or even statues by the window.
While professors lectured inside, crowds learned by proxy outside.
To such shenanigans, the professors had a tacit agreement:
"Enlightening the foolish is, after all, a Sage's sacred duty."

2303005.name: Wave-Chasing Fish
2303005.description: At the start of the enemy target's turn, the clearance threshold for "<u>Murmur</u>" increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect is stackable. For each DoT state other than "<u>Murmur</u>," the threshold additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2303005.shortDesc: At the start of enemy target's turn, increases "<u>Murmur</u>" clearance threshold. The more DoT states inflicted, the higher the increase.
2303005.lore:
The mothers of Styxia all say, don't be like the wave-chasing fish.
Empty-headed, drifting with the current, having no idea where to go.
But the fishermen say they prefer these wave-chasing fish.
They always move sluggishly, even with half their bodies eaten by sea beasts.
Once a sea siren tried to guide them with her song,
yet couldn't fill the void in their eyes.
Fortunately, they are as numerous as the stars, so the ocean isn't left empty.
Whenever such stories are told, scholars always shake their heads and sigh:
If not for their nature, they could have grown enormous,
so large that the entire ocean couldn't contain them.

2303006.name: Masked Stranger
2303006.description: Converts <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of ally target's Shield Effect into "<u>Blazar</u>." After performing a Follow-Up ATK, grant all allies a Shield equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of their ATK for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
2303006.shortDesc: The Shield Effect obtained by ally targets can be converted to "<u>Blazar</u>". After performing a Follow-Up ATK, grant a Shield to all allies.
2303006.lore:
Stay away from the mountains west of Paphas,
unless you wish to experience a jest before death.
A strange visitor has claimed the paths there,
promising to bring fair judgment to all who pass.
He calls himself Thanatos' messenger, yet shows no fear of death.
With Talanton's scales in hand, he delivers verdicts as fickle as the weather.
If he stops you, you must place your treasured possession on the scales,
then you may leave alive, if it weighs less than three feathers.
Sometimes though, he'll pull out a coin, suggesting another round.
Once you meet him, your fate lies in destiny's hands.
Until brave souls defeated him and removed his mask,
only to find beneath it, another mask, forever frozen.

2304001.name: Seaside Siren
2304001.description: When an ally character and their memosprite gain "<u>Obsession</u>," they accumulate an equal number of Charge stacks. Upon reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stacks, they enter the "Dirge" state. When a character in the "Dirge" state launches an attack, they consume <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Charge stacks to deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> instances of "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP to the attacked enemy target. The state ends when Charge stacks reach 0. Charge stacks can still be accumulated while in the "Dirge" state.
2304001.shortDesc: When an ally character and their memosprite gain "<u>Obsession</u>," they accumulate an equal number of Charge stacks. Upon reaching a certain number of stacks, they enter the "Dirge" state. While in this state, after ally characters launch attacks, they consume Charge stacks to deal additional "<u>Aftertaste</u>" DMG. The state ends when Charge stacks reach 0. Charge stacks can still be accumulated while in "Dirge" state.
2304001.lore:
Listen, the waves have brought new memories:
Shells and grains of sand, once a ruin of the city-state.
Their surfaces are etched with stories, each scratch like the rings of a tree.
Creatures called sirens gather them, marking them with their claws.
This one is a surprise from Zagreus,
and that one carries tales from Oronyx.
When their nests overflow with trinkets, the sirens scatter them back to sea.
Leaving only ethereal poetry to chronicle their hidden secrets.
Ah, people say sirens are man-eating monsters.
Yet who has noticed they are also masterful poets?
So, passing traveler, if you meet a bird with a human face on the shore,
don't rush to flee. Sit down and listen to their song.
They'll tell you of memories that no human has ever read.

2304002.name: Mortal Beings
2304002.description: Under the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, each time all allies consume 1 Skill Point, DMG taken by all enemies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, stackable up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state and consuming a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Points for the first time, recover <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> attack count(s) of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," and before this "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state ends, after ally targets attack, deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG (excluding Additional DMG) to the attacked target. This effect also applies to DoT taken by enemy targets at the start of their turn.
2304002.shortDesc: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, the more Skill Points consumed by all allies, the higher the DMG dealt to all enemies. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state and consuming a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Points for the first time in that state, recover "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" count(s) and enable attacks and DoT to deal additional True DMG.
2304002.lore:
I am no hero,
I am one among countless ordinary souls.
Some say I'm the protagonist behind epic tales,
while some say I'm the steps that lift heroes high.
I don't know, I'm just trying to survive, like my kindred across the lands.
I am born, I grow, I procreate, I die.
I am the endless cycle of all the above.
Through me, ancestral stories live on. Through me, civilization's tapestry unfolds.
Sometimes, often, or every moment, I too question life's meaning.
Yet I keep on living,
building a family, bearing children,
like moss growing in the cracks of stone.
Living itself is the answer.

2304003.name: Gate of Yactor
2304003.description: After an ally target uses an attack, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> fixed chance to add 1 Weakness of a random Type to a random attack target, prioritizing Weakness Type that the enemy target does not already have. The applied Weakness is removed after the enemy target is Weakness Broken. After adding a weakness to an enemy target, applies <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Harmonize</u>" to the enemy target and records the added Weakness once. This effect can only trigger up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per action. When any enemy target is Weakness Broken, based on the recorded weaknesses, each record deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Break effect of corresponding Type to the target and adjacent targets.
2304003.shortDesc: After an ally target uses an attack, there is a chance to add 1 random Type Weakness to a random attack target, which is removed after that enemy target is Weakness Broken. After adding a weakness to an enemy target, additionally adds "<u>Harmonize</u>" and records the added Weakness. When any enemy target is Broken, based on the recorded weaknesses, deals corresponding Type Break effect to the target and adjacent targets.
2304003.lore:
Some guard the gates, while others become the gates themselves.
When the armies of Strife trampled through the gates of Janus, burning the temple to ashes,
Yactor wasn't there.
As a warrior, he failed to protect his comrades. As a priest, he failed to stop the sacrilege.
Yet as the defeated, he still had a chance for revenge.
When the holy city's allied forces set out to quell the Strife, he volunteered to join.
With the Axe of Janus, he cleaved open the Century Gate using his own being as the keystone, forging a passage for the army of vengeance.
Covering a thousand miles in a flash, the warriors descended like a divine strike, cutting down the enemy host.
The Gate of Yactor stood fast, enduring the passage of all who crossed its threshold,
until another strife swept it into ruin.

2304004.name: Selfless Giant Turtle
2304004.description: "Giant Turtle's Breath" appears in Action Order: When taking action, increases DMG taken by all enemies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> turns, performs 3 Barrages on all enemies, dealing Ice and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u>, delays their actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, and reduces <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Toughness from all enemy targets ignoring Weakness Type. When Weakness Break occurs on an enemy, triggers both Ice and Fire Weakness Break effects. When ally target activates Ultimate with "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," "Giant Turtle's Breath" action advances by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>.
2304004.shortDesc: "Giant Turtle's Breath" appears in Action Order. When taking action, increases the DMG taken by all enemies, deals Ice and Fire DMG to all enemies, delays their actions, and reduces Toughness from all enemy targets while ignoring Weakness Type. If Weakness Break occurs, triggers both Ice and Fire Weakness Break effects. When ally target activates Ultimate with "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," "Giant Turtle's Breath" action advances.
2304004.lore:
Legend tells of a giant turtle that roamed the world in the distant Era Chrysea.
It, too, was a creation of Earth, even larger than the dromas.
Day and night bestowed their blessings upon it, as sunlight and moonlight etched patterns on its shell.
People built their city-states beside it, listening to its words of wisdom and sharing in its knowledge.
The stories the giant turtle told were more ancient than the rings of time. Even the seismic Giant Dragon was deeply captivated.
It taught people how to till the soil, identify minerals, and observe the trails of sun, moon, and stars...
Day after day, year after year, until one day, people discovered its body had turned to stone.
For it had given away all its knowledge, leaving only its own chest behind.
Thus, a forest was born upon its back,
and to this day, it continues to flourish.

3102001.name: Relative Winner
3102001.description: When an ally target consumes HP, they gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of "<u>Obsession</u>." This can trigger up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) and can be triggered again after any unit takes action.
3102001.shortDesc: When an ally target loses HP, gains "<u>Obsession</u>".
3102001.lore:
Ha! Aha's divine power? As if anyone cares. It's nothing but a gimmick to generate buzz and bring attention to my company. Win or lose? What does it matter? Whoever controls the media controls the world. With a few clicks, I can make myself the victor in every story. I write my own name that never existed on the roll-call, fabricate miracles that never happened, and then... all I have to do is sit back and watch the money roll into my pockets.
Let them curse and doubt all they want. Outrage is the privilege of the weak. If ninety percent of viewers see me as the winner, what can they possibly do about it? I'm the winner. Winner takes all. In a world where everyone entertains themselves till the end, the "truth" on screen is worth more than the facts.

3102002.name: Close Friends
3102002.description: When a memosprite disappears, restores 1 Skill Point to ally targets. For every 1 Skill Point the team gains, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102002.shortDesc: When a memosprite disappears, recovers 1 Skill Point for ally targets. For every 1 Skill Point the team gains, increases DMG dealt by all allies.
3102002.lore:
Hey, don't tell me you've forgotten me! I'm your ride-or-die, your closest friend, your shadow. Now, dig through those memories of yours... When you first fell while learning to ride a bike, I was the one who helped you up. And that person standing right next to you in your graduation photo? That's me, plain as day.
Good, you're starting to remember. I was there waiting for you after school, listening to your dinner-time rants, and giving you dating advice. I'm closer than family, or I could be, if you'd just save a little space for me in your memories.
Help me out here. Keep your eyes on your best friend, and spare a little Wishpower for an old pal.

3102003.name: Pun-ishing Gourmet
3102003.description: While allies' "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks exceed <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>, increases Ultimate DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and memosprite DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102003.shortDesc: While all allies have more than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks, increases DMG dealt by Ultimate and DMG dealt by memosprites.
3102003.lore:
I'm Gerdaki, a memetic lifeform. Watch me cheese the Phantasmoon Games. As long as I rewrite every arcadian's mind and make them pour their Wishpower into me, it'll be a piece of cake.
Except I was late to the party. Their brains are already packed with trashy memes: short videos, reaction pics, earworms, and weird streamers... Seriously, do you guys have any standards?
I've started purging these trash, devouring and destroying them. Every clip you scroll through while eating, running, or even on the toilet is my enemy. It's me versus the whole of Planarcadia. But honestly, I think I'm turning into one of them...
Heh! No way. I'm not going down like this!

3102004.name: Master of Sharing
3102004.description: While ally targets possess "<u>Obsession</u>" increases their All-Type RES PEN by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Every "<u>Obsession</u>" stack increases all ally targets' Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
3102004.shortDesc: While ally targets have "<u>Obsession</u>," increase their All-Type RES PEN. Every "<u>Obsession</u>" stack increases all allies' Break Effect.
3102004.lore:
All eyes on me, Planarcadia! From this moment on, everyone can be a Supplicant! You might think I've downed too many expired jokes at the "World's End," but just look at my gear: panoramic cameras, haptic sensors, and phased array antennas. From every breath to every stride, from joy to sorrow, my every moment is synced with yours.
You'll witness Supplicants fight tooth and nail against each other through my eyes, and feel the exhilarating thrill of sliding down a rainbow firsthand. Not only that, but my every action from here on will be decided by your upvotes! What are you waiting for? Let's get moving and play the Phantasmoon Games our way!

3102005.name: Maze of Eternal Massacre
3102005.description: Increases enemy target's DoT by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After receiving Follow-Up ATK, gains "<u>Murmur</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold.
3102005.shortDesc: Increases enemy target's DoT. After receiving Follow-Up ATK, charges "<u>Murmur</u>".
3102005.lore:
Another reincarnation. I wake at the entrance of the maze, about to slay the nine-headed beast yet again. I don't understand... almost every civilization in the cosmos has its own legend of a hero defeating a monster. Why is this performance worth the attention of millions of alien tourists every year?
I stand before the monster. It lowers its head helplessly, exhausted, but its instincts force it to attack. It's our settings, the sole value of our existence. The programming of this maze has long been broken. Is it a prayer, a divination, or a gamble? Who knows why our departed ancestors created such a game? Yet now, we're but backed up data in a colosseum. Drat, I got distracted.
Another reincarnation. I wake at the entrance of the maze.

3102006.name: Fabled Land
3102006.description: When enemy targets enter combat, they are inflicted with the Bleed effect. While Bleeding, they will take Physical DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP at the start of their turn. This DMG cannot exceed <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of all ally targets' total HP.
3102006.shortDesc: When an enemy target enters combat, inflicts Bleed on them, making them take Physical DoT at the beginning of the turn.
3102006.lore:
They say when Daekians return home, they often find that their doors wouldn't open from this side.
They say Daekians actually dissolve in water.
They say Daekians can enter a quantum state via rolling, rendering them immune to all attacks.
They say you might fall through the ground when you roll around on the planet Daek, as secret tunnels will be triggered. Of course, you will fall even if you're not rolling, because there's a hole there.
They say if you pick up a stone on Daek, the stone will bite you.
They say all of this is because the Plasma Torch Tower extinguished, leaving Daek shrouded in a cloud of probability. The Daekians tried to flee in a spaceship, but the lever in the hangar wouldn't budge.
They say the fire bestowed by Aha can briefly disperse the probability cloud.
They say a brave soul tried to reignite the torch, but he fell into a hole along the way and hasn't been able to climb out since.

3102007.name: Reverse Adventurer
3102007.description: After "Dealer" uses an attack, inflicts Burn on the target. At the start of each turn, the target receives Fire DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of "<u>Dealer's</u>" <u>base DMG</u>, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3102007.shortDesc: After the "<u>Dealer</u>" uses an attack, inflicts Burn on the attack target. At the start of each turn, the target takes Fire DoT, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3102007.lore:
Accident after accident. As things go south once more, you begin to curse your destiny. You've braved Epsilon's most perilous space, your crippled ship narrowly missing a void song whale, only to be seized by interstellar pirates. They were then promptly wiped out by Rangers. You escaped with your life and bid them farewell, only to realize you were heading in the exact opposite direction of your destination.
Destiny is mocking you. You head east, only to find yourself in the west. You seek to climb the highest peak, only to drift through a sea of memoria. Your goals remain forever out of reach, yet they always lead to another unforeseen adventure. Oh, Aha... you gaze at the Phantasmoon, hoping the God of Chaos will liberate you from this chaotic life.
But you know all too well: this will only lead to another unforgettable experience, fated to end in disappointment.

3102008.name: Doctor of Delirium
3102008.description: When any enemy targets are defeated, every DoT state it possesses regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy for all allies.
3102008.shortDesc: When any enemy target is defeated, regenerates Energy for all ally targets based on the number of DoT states the target had.
3102008.lore:
Listen, I am not here to seek God's blessing, but to save the God. The moon has infected reason with disease. The closer you get, the more the madness festers. In this self-proclaimed "arcadia," people laugh just for the sake of laughing, having forgotten what's actually funny. Laughter had turned from a result to a motive.
Do not worry, and there is no need for umbrellas. The potion has been infused into the rain to wash away your rotted hearts. I prefer to call it the "Prescription of Absolute Felicity." You will relearn what it means to feel joy, just like children do, and learn to distinguish it from madness. You will return to your kind, original nature and reclaim your long-lost innocence.
In the end, even the God will be healed. No more mocking and contempt, and no more malicious games.

3102009.name: Ancestral War God
3102009.description: Increases ally targets' CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After a memosprite uses an attack, additionally applies <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" to a random attack target.
3102009.shortDesc: Increases ally target's CRIT Rate. After a memosprite uses an attack, additionally inflicts "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" on a random attack target.
3102009.lore:
Ahem... Okay, Chopstick Killer, you win this round. Those five chopsticks of yours are all lethal strikes. There's no way I can block them all!
But as a security officer, it is my duty to stop you. Did you know? My father once fought the "Demon of Renege." My grandfather caught the "Little Green Man" and successfully threw them in prison... All the way back to the Canvas Age, my family has protected this planet for centuries.
I'm not telling you this to brag about my noble bloodline. I'm reminding you that this mask allows me to manifest the power of my ancestors. See that ghost on your left? That's my father. The ghost on your right is my grandfather. And behind them, and even further back...
Ancestors, assemble!

3102010.name: Bald Creator
3102010.description: For every "<u>Murmur</u>" Charge that equals to 1% of the clearance threshold, increases CRIT DMG taken by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102010.shortDesc: Increases CRIT DMG taken by enemy targets for every 1% of the clearance threshold that the current charge of "<u>Murmur</u>" has reached.
3102010.lore:
Fermin carefully felt the top of his head. Seven strands. Only seven strands of hair remained, fluttering in the cold wind as his final chips on the table. And he still had several grueling matches ahead of him.
The Baldia Hair-Pulling Contest is the most scalp-tingling competition in the cosmos. You win by plucking your opponent completely bald. The match tests not only strength and speed but also hair density. As for the winner, Aha will bestow upon them a perfect, luscious mane.
Squeezing out the last drop of hair-growth cream, Fermin carefully applied it to his roots. Though the effect was negligible, it provided a small bit of psychological comfort.
"If I lose this one, I won't be needing this stuff anymore," Fermin joked to himself as he stepped out to face his opponent.

3102011.name: Vermin Hunter
3102011.description: Increases the DMG dealt by "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Increases the DMG dealt by the attack triggered when using Elation Skill by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102011.shortDesc: Increases DMG dealt with "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>." DMG dealt further increases when using Elation Skill attacks to trigger it.
3102011.lore:
Hello? Is anyone watching? Tied to this table is none other than the infamous fraudster, Mr. Mill. Did you think hiring History Fictionologists to scrub your past would mean no one could find you? Did you think credits and a "not guilty" plea would keep you safe? It's all useless.
From this moment on, I will hunt down every evil that has escaped judgment: murderers, fraudsters, sadists... Go ahead and hide in the deepest depths, hire thugs with blood on their hands, or even turn yourselves in to seek refuge with the Department of Aberration Defense. Everyone will watch through their screens as I grab each of you by the tail and expose your pathetic pleas for mercy.
The roll call has ended. Now... let the game of cat and mouse begin.

3102012.name: Cursed Teacher
3102012.description: For every enemy target defeated, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets in the current battle by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Additionally increases Ultimate DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can stack.
3102012.shortDesc: For every enemy target defeated, increases DMG dealt by ally targets in the current battle, with Ultimate DMG receiving an additional boost.
3102012.lore:
I'm a teacher, and knowledge is my curse. Ever since the AtaviSearch Forest performed "Information Conversion Surgery" on me, that phrase has been more than just a metaphor.
The moment I wake, my knowledge begins to hunt me: *Anatomy* critiques how I wash my face, *Nutrition* tosses out my breakfast, *Kinematics* forces me to ditch the subway and walk to work, only for *Traffic Engineering* to kick me right back onto the train. My dear Supplicant friend, I have no desire to accept your challenge, but I'm afraid *Relativity* and *Astrophysics* are eager to test their mettle against you.
Perhaps I should have studied the arts... they are so much more beautiful and compassionate...

3102013.name: Demon of Renege
3102013.description: Ally targets' Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When entering combat or when a memosprite is summoned, charges "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of each unit's Max HP. Then, when the turn ends, "<u>Blazar</u>" is not depleted.
3102013.shortDesc: Increases Max HP. When entering combat or summoning memosprite, charges "<u>Blazar</u>." Then, when the first turn ends, "<u>Blazar</u>" is not cleared.
3102013.lore:
Okay, okay, I admit it. I'm the one who transferred Miss Beauteous's memories into Mr. Jones. It made an upstanding man such himself show up to work at the café in a maid uniform. And yeah, the matter with Mrs. White was my doing too... oh, the poor little thing, having to fight her own mother for a milk bottle.
Wait, you know about that thing too? Fine, I spill everything! Those fools are still pretending to be stone statues at a particular temple. I just wanted to carry out an experiment! How was I supposed to know rocks could hold a grudge?
There, I've told you everything. Can I go now? What? I have to wait for a trial?
Well then, my apologies, officers. Why don't you take out those shiny handcuffs of yours and cuff yourselves? Hehe, lucky for me I still have a few prisoners' memories left.

3102014.name: Garage Dragon Slayer
3102014.description: Increases ally targets' Effect RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. When resisting debuffs, deals Additional DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of "<u>Blazar</u>" to the target. This DMG cannot defeat enemy targets.
3102014.shortDesc: Increases Effect RES and "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG dealt. When resisting debuffs, deals "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG to the target.
3102014.lore:
"There's a fire-breathing dragon in my garage!" If you lived in ancient Benzaitengoku, you'd be used to hearing that. According to unofficial data, roughly <unbreak>0.03%</unbreak> of Ahatopians encounter a fire-breathing dragon in their garage at least once in their lives, though no instrument can ever detect one.
Later, a dragonslayer named Ahero arrived in Ahatopia, with a <unbreak>72%</unbreak> probability of being a Doctor of Chaos. Amidst the crowd's mockery, he stepped into a garage and, after a while, tossed out a dragon's head. From then on, the anti-memetic dragon was officially registered as a species.
There is, in truth, a fire dragon in everyone's garage. Of course, you won't find them anymore. Let's give a big "Thank you" to Ahero!

3102015.name: Physical Magical Girl
3102015.description: When ally character's HP percentage drops below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for the first time in a single combat, activates Ultimate and allows this unit and memosprite's Ultimate DMG in this combat to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> DEF.
3102015.shortDesc: When ally target's HP percentage drops below <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for the first time in a single combat, activates Ultimate and allows this unit and memosprite's Ultimate DMG in this combat to ignore a portion of enemy target's DEF.
3102015.lore:
"Uh, yeah, I used to be a nomadic miner. Then some cursed tie-wearing dwarf with a piece of paper told me, 'Sign here and I'll double your pay next month.' Then that engineering accident happened, and I ended up with a massive debt."
"Why did I become a magical girl? If I can make money just by punching an aberration into the dirt, is there any better job in the world? It's just... this little skirt always makes me feel a bit uneasy, especially when I'm doing a flying kick... Are you done with the interview? I've got another opponent to deal with."
Under the reporter's watchful gaze, the Supplicant tossed her three-meter-long magic staff into the air and leaped onto it, flying away from the scene.

3102016.name: Aha Radio Station
3102016.description: Increases Shield Effect gained by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Breaking an enemy target's Weakness, all allies obtain a Shield equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3102016.shortDesc: Increases Shield Effect gained. After Breaking the enemy target's Weakness, all allies obtain a Shield.
3102016.lore:
This might be the only planetary-scale case of collective suicide in cosmic history. Jim Jones Star was a planet as ordinary as they come: average climate, average resources, average civilization. That is until the "Aha Radio Station" opened up on a neighboring planet.
Aha Radio Station was founded by a group of (self-proclaimed) Aha believers, aiming to spread the spirit of Elation. Their method was to use high-power radio telescopes to broadcast jokes they'd written themselves to the entire cosmos.
After over a century of enduring unfunny jokes, the poor inhabitants of Jim Jones Star finally suffered a mental breakdown and brought their own civilization to an end. It is said that the final straw was the line: "Humans are born from humans, but imagenae are simply created from imagenae-tion."

3102017.name: Detached Swordmaster
3102017.description: Increases ally targets' Elation by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. For every enemy target defeated, additionally increases it by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102017.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' Elation. With every enemy target defeated, Elation is further increased.
3102017.lore:
This arcadia is incredibly dull, and the lives of the people are cluttered with such boring things. Life is but a fleeting dream, why leave such meaningless stuff behind? I'm here to rewrite this karma and prune the deadwood of fate!
With a flash of my blade, I clear the way. I don't need to look back at the cheering crowd. The feel of the steel tells me everything I need to know. Hmph, another piece of junk cut down. Expired cookies, tacky decor, holiday assignments, ghosted acquaintances, unrequited pining, and even a rebelliously infected appendix. Such stressors shall all be shattered in this instant.
Go ahead, let go of yourself and your obsession, and start enjoying life. Take it from a swordmaster who knows.

3102018.name: Upvoted Twin Stars
3102018.description: After each time "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action, "<u>Blazar</u>" Charging Efficiency increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Stacks up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> times.
3102018.shortDesc: After each action taken by the <u>Dealer</u>, "<u>Blazar's</u>" Charging Efficiency increases.
3102018.lore:
Look at that, ladies and gentlemen! The "Chopstick Killer" has officially landed on the Phantasmoon, ready to duke it out with Supplicant "UnicornOfficial" in the battle of the century! Now, we all know the Phantasmoon usually lacks a physical form, but this time it's actually answered the call and manifested in the low-Earth orbit.
The first wave of fan support is gonna rocket up there any second now. Let's see what everyone's prepared for them: Lollipops, chopsticks, hay, a horse bridle, antimatter annihilation missiles, a stretch of rainbow... Excellent! Hopefully our two combatants can make full use of these weapons and put on one heck of a show for us.
Oh wait, lemme just toss in a couple of planetary band-aids too! Wouldn't want the Phantasmoon getting beaten up too badly.

3102019.name: Drinksmith
3102019.description: Increases ally targets' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After each time "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action, additionally increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> the next time they use their Basic ATK or Skill.
3102019.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' CRIT DMG. After each action taken by the "<u>Dealer</u>," additionally increases all allies' CRIT DMG for their next Basic ATK/Skill.
3102019.lore:
I've heard too many jokes and brewed them into fine wine. Tragic love songs taste bitter, while the death of planets is heavy. Jokes about politicians are always spicy, children's games often refreshing. But no Fool stays in the tavern forever, and I, too, must choose to journey far.
So let me dedicate this cocktail to all of you, a joke that's uniquely mine. It will be passed from mouth to ear tonight before everyone savors its mellow aroma that lingers through this long story, and forgets it once they sober up. The whispers that erupted when the Eagle Ring was obliterated, the actor painting a portrait for the wandering youth, the deafening cheers when the Wrath King died, the flamboyant young man clinking glasses with an old friend.
As for the final drink, I'll leave it to you, beautiful moon, as a farewell to the "World's End."

3102020.name: Heartbroken Soul
3102020.description: Increases ally targets' Elation DMG's Weakness Break Efficiency by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After inflicting Weakness Break on an enemy target, increases the unit's SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102020.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' Elation DMG's Weakness Break Efficiency. After inflicting Weakness Break on an enemy target, increases the unit's SPD.
3102020.lore:
Those who grieve, let me soothe your sorrows. I know the flames of war are spreading across Ahatopia, and the Legion has taken fathers and mothers, sons and daughters. I know I cannot heal the scars upon this land, nor am I as mighty as the giant of frost or the painter Graphia, who are strong enough to stand against the Demons From Beyond.
But there are still things I can do. I can share your grief and bring courage back to your hearts. I can bear your suffering, so that the cold nights no longer echo with cries of anguish. I can listen to the voices in the darkness and find children who still draw breath. So please, take my hand... and don't let go...
O Aha above, as a Mourning Actor, I beseech YOU to save the smiles of this world.

3102021.name: Ability Raffle Competition
3102021.description: After a memosprite attacks, "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" Charges for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> with a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> chance to recover <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s).
3102021.shortDesc: Memosprites using attacks can Charge "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" with a chance to recover Skill Points.
3102021.lore:
The Yindorans have their own unique philosophy of survival. The elders here condense their most precious life experiences into Memory Bubbles before they pass, then pass them down to the next generation. Unfortunately, this inheritance is done through a lottery system, turning every ceremony into a game of chance.
You might be a hunter, but end up drawing the ability to gossip with folks at the village entrance. You might be a scribe, but get stuck with the skill to identify poisonous mushrooms.
On the bright side, every Yindoran is a jack-of-all-trades.

3102022.name: Planetary Bumper Cars
3102022.description: Increases the True DMG multiplier of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier. Every debuff on the enemy target additionally increases this by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier.
3102022.shortDesc: Increases the True DMG of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>." Every debuff on the enemy target additionally increases the multiplier.
3102022.lore:
Child, it's time to reveal the truth of the universe for you: That giant fireball in the sky isn't a star, but a light bulb. All the light and heat in this segmentum comes from this blessing from the Aeon of Elation.
Right now, we're sitting in the spot closest to it. But the number of suitable orbits is limited, and other planets have their eyes on our location. That's why we gotta steer our home and ram them out of the way. This is a battle for our world's survival, where winners get a long, warm summer, while losers freeze through an endless winter.
The next collision is about to kick off. Don't worry, with me at the helm, we'll stay right where we belong, in the perfect spot.

3102023.name: Empathetic Cupcake
3102023.description: Increases the CRIT DMG of ally targets when they use Basic ATK or Skill by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. For every 1 Skill Point consumed, gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points of Punchline.
3102023.shortDesc: Increases CRIT DMG dealt when ally targets use Basic ATK or Skill. For every 1 Skill Point consumed, gains Punchline.
3102023.lore:
It was my tenth birthday. Halfway through the birthday song, the cake on the table started making a ruckus. It smeared its frosting to draw a pair of glasses, then began lecturing us about its ingredients and nutritional value. After that, it started advertising for its manufacturer.
The Department of Aberration Defense slapped seals on every cake. They said this Aberration came from the Phantasmoon Games that had just ended, and that they'd destroy every last terrifying cake. But I just couldn't bear to part with it, so I secretly hid a slice in the refrigerator. It was my best friend, but every time we had a heart-to-heart, it would urge me to eat it.
You're asking what happened afterwards? Well, one time the power went out, and I was worried the cake would go bad, so I... *sigh* I really miss that taste...

3102024.name: Flipping Ant
3102024.description: Ally targets' Basic ATK DMG and Skill DMG ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the enemy target's DEF. This effect increases to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> on enemy targets in the Weakness Broken state.
3102024.shortDesc: Basic ATK DMG and Skill DMG dealt ignore a certain percentage of the enemy target's DEF. This effect additionally increases on Weakness Broken enemy targets.
3102024.lore:
The following is a behavioral observation record of the Othello Ant Colony (No. <unbreak>80</unbreak>):
After Queen A's soldiers invaded Queen B's nest, the alpha-type pheromones carried by the worker ants began to spread. Due to enemy soldiers blocking the passage, Queen A's soldiers were affected by the pheromones at the invasion point after two system hours, their physiological characteristics rapidly changed, and they switched allegiance to accept Queen B's commands. This phenomenon occurred repeatedly throughout the war between the two colonies, until Queen A successfully occupied the opponent's nest.
We have no way of knowing how long this game of reversals has continued on this planet, but it will surely end soon. Based on the current situation, Colony No. <unbreak>80</unbreak> will assimilate the entire northern continent within <unbreak>10</unbreak> days, including the observation station. Everything will be— *Gah gah, ga ga, ga ga*

3102025.name: Shadowchasing Mechagod
3102025.description: Each stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" additionally deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of ATK when triggered. After using an Ultimate to attack, applies an extra <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" to all targets hit.
3102025.shortDesc: Each stack of <u>"Reverse Critical Boost"</u> additionally deals DMG when it is triggered. After using an Ultimate to attack, additionally applies <u>"Reverse Critical Boost"</u> to all attack targets.
3102025.lore:
Aha brought many games to the universe, and the Fools, emulating the gods, crafted miracles of Elation.
When the Iron King fell, Rubert's creation rose in mourning and fury to exact revenge. Horrifying gears crushed wails, and rusted weapons melted civilization. I found its traces on a withered gas giant and invited it to join a game meant for only itself.
I clipped a sliver of humanity's phantasm and placed it before the Sun, along with a mask. A long shadow fell eternally beyond the terminator line, and the machine, drawn to it, chased the shifting line under scorching sunlight, desperate to erase the last of humanity.
You can still see it there to this day, like a child afraid of the dark, chasing the burning clouds at the edge of dusk.

3102026.name: Cosmic Bakery
3102026.description: Increases ally target's "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, after using Ultimate, gain "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
3102026.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG, and gains "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge after using Ultimate.
3102026.lore:
If you want to win over a god, you must win over THEIR stomach first, so writes Volume Nine of the fragmented *The Ultra-Cosmic Baking Compendium*. Whenever the land of Tonbas begins to tremble, the game to please Aha will soon kick off.
You witness the Structuralist School of Baking craft a full moon using three nested layers of space, then push it into the hollow of the planet's core. Not even the echo of its descent rings out. Clearly, the god remains unsatisfied. You pluck an unclaimed satellite, melt its core with beams of light, and sprinkle it with stardust yet to cool. As a Fundamentalist School baker, each of your steps is a faithful reconstruction, like molecular gastronomy itself.
The enormous lava cake is pulled by gravity, plummeting into the abyss. And you wait with bated breath: Will Aha let out a laugh of satisfaction and bestow upon you the recipe for the cosmos's finest dessert?

3102027.name: Self-Contemplating Scholar
3102027.description: Increases the CRIT DMG of ally targets' Ultimate DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action, Charges <u>"Brain in a Vat"</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for all ally characters.
3102027.shortDesc: Increases the CRIT DMG of ally targets' Ultimate DMG. After the <u>"Dealer"</u> takes action, charges <u>"Brain in a Vat"</u> for ally characters.
3102027.lore:
Aha once said, the world works however I reckon it does. Don't let those phonies posing as scientists pull the wool over your eyes. They go on about gravity running the show. But I say if you just quit thinkin' about fallin', you ain't gonna fall. See? I'm floatin' just fine. They say a Perpetual Engine can't exist, but my UFO cobbled together from wood scraps and old tin is flying right here, ain't it? They say what I do isn't real science, but mere distortions of reality. But if you ask me, they're all spouting nonsense.
I'm gonna smash their garbage theories to bits and spread the truth so y'all know that time is a substance, coldness and heat are both particles. Every electron in the universe is one and the same, and matter can be generated out of thin air.
Folks, don't you dare blink, 'cause I'm about to contemplate the very framework that runs this universe.

3102028.name: Card Game Rookie
3102028.description: For every 1 Skill Point consumed by an ally target, increases their Ultimate DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and lasting until after using their Ultimate.
3102028.shortDesc: The more Skill Points ally targets consume, the more Ultimate DMG is dealt.
3102028.lore:
With the Golden Toilet summoned onto the field in a game of cards, my opponent's defeat was all but assured. The Laughter scattered THEIR wondrous cards, measuring all things in the universe. I crushed my job interview rival with powerful cards, my deck lineup intimidated those scary grannies who loved to cut the line. I used masterful plays to defeat the former King of Carder, winning the right to play for every kid in the slums.
Ah, Magic Card, what a magnificent art you are. You anchor the scores of exams and competitions, and settle the outcomes of wars and disputes. Even the weekend sale rush at the supermarket is decided by you.
And now, the final moment has arrived. At last, I can claim the reward granted by the God of Elation to the champion... Ah, Magic Card, the one and only Magic Card in the entire universe.

3102029.name: Homeland Rebuilder
3102029.description: Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" increases Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Memosprite's Break Effect additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
3102029.shortDesc: "<u>Obsession</u>" increases Break Effect and additionally increases memosprites' Break Effect.
3102029.lore:
I still remember that general store by the school gate, with glass jars brimming with rainbow candies of every color.
I remember the shopping district during holidays, fireworks blooming in the sky reflected in people's eyes.
I even remember that little blade of grass in the corner back home, whose delicate body still stands after years of wind and rain.
But now everything has changed. I'm trapped in a painting, alongside countless others, and the homeland I once knew has become a place I can never return to.
But thanks be to Aha, THEY bestowed upon me the role of Supplicant, entrusting me with the sacred mission of returning home.
I will offer up my own fabric of memories, and let it merge into the grand endeavor of rebuilding our nation.
I need more people to join in, to rebuild that once-prosperous country from countless fragments scattered across this desolate sea of memories.

3102030.name: Encounter With a Miracle Doctor
3102030.description: When any ally target used an attack to inflict a debuff on enemy targets, apply <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Harmonize</u>" to the enemy targets. If the targets are Weakness Broken, the applied stacks are doubled.
3102030.shortDesc: When an attack inflicts a debuff on an enemy, additionally applies "<u>Harmonize</u>." If the enemy is Weakness Broken, applies doubled "<u>Harmonize</u>" stacks.
3102030.lore:
No, I will never leave this room! Have you all forgotten what that Doctor of Chaos did last time? His bizarre potion turned into a fog that enveloped the city. Stones gained magnetic force and embraced gravel, trees bent down to kiss the soil. My room dissolved in an instant, I lost control of my limbs and walked the streets like a marionette, hugging strangers.
He claimed this was the remedy to get over nothingness, that perfect encounters would bring laughter for tomorrow. But matter began to melt, and all those bound by unknown forces fused together, becoming one. I saw the object of my affection, and then what happened...
We won't go out. I'd rather die in this cramped room than let people see this face.

3102031.name: Knights of Arcadia
3102031.description: Increases the DMG multiplier of "<u>Harmonize</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After ally targets launch a Follow-Up ATK, applies <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Harmonize</u>" to the targets.
3102031.shortDesc: Increases "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG. After ally targets launch a Follow-Up ATK, additionally applies "<u>Harmonize</u>."
3102031.lore:
Do you remember this day all those years ago? Back then, the arcadia wasn't nearly as absurd as it is today. A group of kids bought masks from a shop in the amusement park, and The Laughter, more than happy to stir the pot, made all five children masters of the same mask. But what miracles could children possibly create? It was nothing more than a clumsy game of make-believe.
They raised their wooden swords and set sail on a grand ship toward the legendary Jelly Island. Their loyal guard was a kind-hearted orch, and their weathered captain was an elderly ploo. They encountered the brave Bullet Wyrm and defeated the witch, played by none other than the head of the Department of Aberration Defense herself. And so, the five were knighted as the great Knights of Arcadia, and this performance, joined by a million people, came to an end.
See? This sword at my waist was a gift from that day.

3102032.name: Particle Annihilation Force
3102032.description: When an ally target uses their Basic ATK or Skill, ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the enemy target's All-Type RES. After attacking with a Basic ATK or Skill, reduces the enemy target's Toughness by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points, regardless of Weakness Type.
3102032.shortDesc: When an ally target uses their Basic ATK/Skill, they ignore a certain amount of the enemy target's All-Type RES. After attacking with their Basic ATK/Skill, they reduce the enemy target's Toughness by a fixed amount, ignoring Weakness Type.
3102032.lore:
My darling, I have wonderful news! We can finally embrace. Your father has left the pulsar to attend the Phantasmoon Games or whatever you call it, and the electromagnetic repulsion that kept us apart no longer exists.
Of course I know you're matter and I'm antimatter, that we'll explode at the slightest touch, but annihilation is only temporary. After that, a new consciousness will be born in the particles where you and I overlap. I can feel your magnetic field reaching out to me. Don't be afraid. Even if it means becoming a brilliant burst of fireworks, I want to share this romance with you.
You old fool! I know action at a distance links our kind's vision, but it's too late even if you come back now. You can never stop electrons in love from drawing close and spiraling together.

3102033.name: Life Dissection Expert
3102033.description: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, DMG taken by enemy targets increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and DMG taken from memosprites additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102033.shortDesc: Increases DMG dealt to enemy targets in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, and additionally increases DMG taken from memosprites.
3102033.lore:
Do you still remember the time... when you tasted your first popsicle at seven, took a tumble on the roboball court at twelve, watched fireworks with your partner for the first time at sixteen... Those moments are still there, like light trapped in amber, but no one can ever truly own them, not like you did back then.

That's why I chose to take cross-sections of my own past. Look at the figures on this stage — each one is a version of me, frozen in a single moment, never to fade. As a child, I always carried hope for the future. As a boy, I grew stronger with every setback. And as a young man, I was... someone who never forgot her.

Truth be told, even I am not the self I once was, but this technology has come astonishingly close to perfection. Don't wanna grow up? Don't wanna grow old? Don't wanna be forgotten after you're gone? All it takes is a little work with my scalpel.

3102034.name: I'm Tired, Boss
3102034.description: For every debuff an enemy target has, DMG dealt decreases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3102034.shortDesc: For every debuff an enemy target is afflicted with, decreases the DMG dealt by them and increases the DMG taken by them.
3102034.lore:
If a thousand wispae can form a single massive imagenae, and a million wispae are enough to flatten half a city, try to imagine something like this: One day, as the dusk draws near, people gaze out at the setting sun or at the scrambled day-and-night cycle left behind by that wretched Supplicant from centuries ago, and millions of sighs rise all at once: I'm tired. Let's just give it all up.

And so, a shadow is born in silence beneath the veil of night. It subsumes the towering skyscrapers, the winding alleyways, and everything humanity has ever depended on to survive. It tries, without purpose or reason, to digest it all, and fails. Because once again, it hears millions upon millions of sighs drifting its way: Ah, never mind. We'll make do.

And then, it dies, without a sound, before any Supplicant ever finds it or brings it to justice.

3102035.name: Trivia Train
3102035.description: After an ally target takes action, gains 1 stack of "Piercing Shards," and gains 1 additional stack after launching a Follow-Up ATK or Support Skill. "Piercing Shards": For each stack, when dealing Ultimate DMG, ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the enemy target's All-Type RES and consumes all "Piercing Shards."
3102035.shortDesc: After an ally target takes action, gains 1 stack of "Piercing Shards", and gains 1 additional stack after launching a Follow-Up ATK or Support Skill. "Piercing Shards": Ultimate ignores a certain percentage of the enemy target's All-Type RES.
3102035.lore:
On the planet Plato, if you say to someone, "Did your brain get waterlogged or something?" they'll take it as the highest compliment, because Platonians literally have liquid brain tissue... It works! Can you hear the roar of my "fun facts" engine revving up?

As the archnemesis of Bullet Wyrm express, I'm already one of the fastest trains in all of arcadia. The chaos plaguing this place is all because this segmentum's cursed, so I'm heading for the starry blue skies, using my sheer raw power to haul Ahatopia out of this segmentum entirely. So, how about a few more fun facts?

Yes, yes! A day on Tarryan lasts thirty-six hours, the Halovers were originally an invasive species, and void song whales aren't actually classified as whales... How do you all know so many fun facts? I can feel the power surging into my combustion chamber. Hold on tight, I'm gonna speed up!

3102036.name: Clean Slay
3102036.description: Increases max limit of "<u>Blazar</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After an ally target launches a Follow-Up ATK, restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
3102036.shortDesc: Increases the Max limit of "<u>Blazar</u>." After ally target launches a Follow-Up ATK, restores HP.
3102036.lore:
I killed for the first time at twenty, to avenge my mother. Three days after that, I killed that murderer's mother, because she wanted revenge for her son. Fifty years on, I killed every last avenger. But I think, young one... today, all of this finally comes to an end.

When I was your age, I'd heard that beyond the walls of this city, "assassins" were villains who killed for coin. Thought it was filthy, shameful, and utterly without honor. And honestly, part of me still does. But now I understand all too clearly — "assassin" is nothing more than an elaborate lie, an endless sacrifice, because people need a ritual to bring this planet's next successor into being.

Pull the trigger, kid. Kill me and walk away. Don't worry about anyone coming for revenge, since there are no more assassins left in this city to carry on the legacy.

3102037.name: Deathly Delightful
3102037.description: After an ally target deals Elation DMG, DMG taken by enemy targets increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3102037.shortDesc: After an ally target deals Elation DMG, increases DMG taken by the enemy target.
3102037.lore:
Strictly speaking, I'm not actually Tokaman himself. He can't run a lap around Duomension City in under a minute, can't win every single round of Rock-Paper-Scissors, and he definitely can't reach through the screen and punch you in the face, at least not outside of meme territory.

I am nothing but a memory, a meme that kept spreading even after Tokaman's death. So when you say "Good morning," my instinct kicks in, and I'll say "Bad morning" right back, then drift over to the window with my hands clasped behind my back. When something inappropriate flashes on screen, I'll whip a knife out of thin air, slash the camera clean in half, and growl in my lowest voice: "Shut up, you scoundrel!"

Do you guys get it? I'm just a memory! Hey, did you just laugh at me!? Just you wait, I'll reach through this screen and punch you in the face!

3102038.name: Soapbox Knight
3102038.description: Increases ally targets' Elation by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the start of a turn or an extra turn, gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Punchline.
3102038.shortDesc: Increases ally target's Elation. At the start of a turn or extra turn, gains Punchline.
3102038.lore:
Engines roared, banners snapped in the wind, and from their lofty stands, the dukes swirled their goblets, feigning indifference as they wondered which family's knight would win the favor of the god of chaos.

Your long years as a retainer came to an end not long ago. Through that decade, you turned over what the world's most absurd vehicle might be, all while quietly holding fast to the knight's creed of justice and humility. Then came the day when an old knight you'd known so well pressed a car key into your palm with his final breath. Standing before a champion forged of salmon, pineapple, and cheese, you couldn't help but feel this was perhaps the most ramshackle knighting ceremony anyone had ever witnessed.

The fluffy bear racer ahead of you lets out a ferocious roar from its engine, its fuzzy aura a weapon to throw opponents off their game. But you know what's really at stake: Nothing beats an engine running on fermented bean juice.

3102039.name: Organic Emperor
3102039.description: For every 1 Skill Point consumed by an ally target, CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3102039.shortDesc: The more Skill Points ally targets consume, the higher the CRIT DMG, and the higher the DMG dealt by Skills and Ultimates.
3102039.lore:
In the immemorial past, an inorganic emperor once sought to crown itself the perfect sage with a scepter. What an absurd joke! Everyone knows that wisdom is the crystallization of organic life. Even the Monarch of Myriad Machines, who peers into the very fabric of the universe, is nothing more than a human creation. And those computing units the Intelligentsia Guild treasures so dearly? Not a single one is more complex than the brain of a common rodent.

Just think about it, if every rodent on this planet were under my command, linked to my brainwaves, could not my world-shaking intellect stand toe-to-toe with Rubert II, who has drained an entire empire's worth of processing power? Toe-to-toe? Heh. I'd wager my intellect has long since surpassed that fool so blindly devoted to the way of metal.

I am the King of All Rats, the Supreme Intellect, I— I— I am the Organic Emperor!

3102040.name: Locked Room Collector
3102040.description: When an ally target uses their Ultimate, for every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Energy consumed, increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s), and gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Punchline. Each time, at least <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> Energy is taken into account.
3102040.shortDesc: When ally target uses Ultimate, the more Energy consumed, the more CRIT DMG increases, and gains extra Punchline.
3102040.lore:
Hello there, dear friend. You may call me the "Locked Room Collector," a detective of sorts... purely out of passion.

Wherever a murder occurs in a locked room, I'll be there to crack the case. Though I should mention, solving the mystery is my department, while catching the culprit is not. After all, I'm just a detective who does this for fun.

What? You're saying it's obvious I staged the whole thing myself? From the standpoint of "objective truth," sure, you could say that. However, no one will even notice this, because ever since that imagenesis incident at the library, people automatically perceive any space I occupy as a "locked room." They call it a "counter-memetic condition," which I prefer to think of as a talent.

Besides, this is Phantasmoon Games we're talking about here. Who are we even trying to impress with all that objectivity?

So, stay quiet, trust me, and you'll make a wonderful mystery.

3102041.name: Multi-Playthrough Civilization
3102041.description: When dealing Ultimate DMG, ally target's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. DMG taken by enemy targets in the Weakness Broken state increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3102041.shortDesc: When dealing Ultimate DMG, ally target's Weakness Break Efficiency increases. DMG taken by enemy targets in the Weakness Broken state increases.
3102041.lore:
A genius might shake Nous's thoughts, but for most beings in the cosmos, civilization is like the digits of pi, stretching on forever, with nothing left to do but check the math endlessly. We knew this all too well. Twenty full Amber Eras of futile searching proved that civilization had reached the very ceiling of truth. And so, we made the decision to reduce ourselves to zero.

We sealed away civilization and memories, and like newborns, returned barefoot to the savage age of slash-and-burn. We rekindled a campfire in the mud, reproved geometry on clay tablets, cheered at the rediscovery of gears and equations, and wept as we watched rockets rise into the starry sky. When the deviation between our civilization and the save file fell below three thousandths, the accounting machines buried deep within the planet's core began to bellow once more, the celebration arrived as promised, and we splurged everything we had reclaimed. Then, after the fireworks cooled down, once more we pressed the button to restart civilization.

Within the forgotten cyclicality, we are given the chance to relive the thrill of discovery and enlightenment.

3102042.name: Dining Etiquette
3102042.description: After an ally target's HP or Shield decreases, the next time they attack a Weakness Broken enemy target, the Toughness Reduction of this attack is converted into 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
3102042.shortDesc: After ally target's HP or Shield is reduced, deals additional <u>Super Break DMG</u> after the next attack.
3102042.lore:
On Taboris, table manners are everything, and that goes for everyone, Oswaldo included. Every dinner is a full-blown ceremony. If you actually want to make it through a meal in peace, you've got at least three gauntlets to run:

The first gauntlet is called "Respect." A Pepeshi who unwittingly sat in the seat of honor vanishes before everyone's eyes, and the fish head swings to point at the next one to be eliminated. Cold sweat trickles down your forehead.
The second gauntlet is called "Bottoms Up." You chug a cocktail brewed from jokes, and the purple humor burns your throat. The Intellitron next to you short-circuits from a pun and dissolves into hysterical laughter, sending screws bouncing across the table.
The third gauntlet is called "The Morning After." As the ceiling starts to melt, the neon lights breaking into a dance, the entire planet begins to spin, and one by one, you all let the floor introduce itself to your faces.

Your naive stomach has carried you to the very end. Congratulations, you've earned yourself a seat at the next banquet.

3103001.name: Horticulturist
3103001.description: After an ally target uses an attack, deals Additional DMG to the target equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP. After <u>"Dealer"</u> takes action, the Additional DMG of the next attack is increased to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
3103001.shortDesc: After an ally target uses an attack, deals Additional DMG to the attack target based on Max HP. After the "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action, the next Additional DMG is increased.
3103001.lore:
Truth is, forget the Supplicant thing, I see myself as an artist.
You know what's wrong with modern humans? The "modern" part. Cooped up in a concrete zoo, grinding till you drop. When's the last time you just broke into song at work? Danced? I wanna wake up what the land remembers and summon a forest right in the middle of the city! From your bedroom to the subway station heading to Duomension City, and the internet won't escape either. This memetic cyber-jungle's gonna spread through every block and alley till there's no "modern" left. That's my installation art.
Yeah, yeah, I should've filed a report with your Aberration Defense people. My bad. But hey, I've gotta hit Dovebrook first. Later. If I make it back, I'll apologize properly. Promise.

3103002.name: History Agent
3103002.description: For each stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" ally target has, ally target's Basic ATK and Skill DMG dealt increase by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When an ally character departs from the field, is knocked down, or when an ally memosprite disappears, the character in position 1 in the current team obtains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of that ally's "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks and an equal amount of "<u>Obsession</u>" max limit. This additional stack limit will disappear after <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3103002.shortDesc: Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" increases Basic ATK and Skill DMG. Upon leaving the field, the first character in the current team obtains a certain percentage of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
3103002.lore:
A thousand years ago, the planet's memory core hit its limit, and only what truly mattered could be stored. History dies. Only the strong live on. The Golden State devoured its neighbors, fed their ridiculous chronicles into the core... and then got crushed by the Orange Coalition.
The machine spirit, thoroughly entertained by these foolish mortals, handed down an oracle: let's play a game. A fair fight to decide which memories are worth keeping. The agents of every state duke it out in the arena. Winner takes all, and etches one memory into the genes of every living thing.
You step onto the finals stage and pray to the book in your hand. Then, everyone sees its title — *One Hundred Facts About Toilets*.

3103003.name: Wheel of Career Transition
3103003.description: Increases max "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks of allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>, and increases SPD by an additional <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> for each "<u>Obsession</u>" stack for all allies. When breaking an enemy's Weakness, all allies gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks.
3103003.shortDesc: Increases the maximum number of "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks. Each "<u>Obsession</u>" stack increases all allies' SPD. All allies obtain "<u>Obsession</u>" when any enemy target is Broken.
3103003.lore:
Good morning, citizens of the Marty Alliance. By Aha's grace, another orbit's come and gone. Your fresh carbon-based body is ready to go, and your profession will be randomly selected from the available pool. Care to guess what you'll be this time? Fleet Commander? Plumber? Or maybe the ever-popular Alliance President?
The knowledge and skill sets tied to your new profession will be injected directly into your body along with your new identity. First-time participants, please prepare yourselves mentally for a completely new identity, life, and social circle. If you do happen to draw interstellar dinosaur, don't sweat it. Your consciousness will re-enter the profession rotation process after you're hunted down. Time's up, let me see what I'm gonna be... Huh? What do you mean "Supreme Holy Swordmaster of Radical Awesomeness"?

3103004.name: Eternal Sprint
3103004.description: DoTs taken by enemy targets can CRIT. The CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG is equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of all ally characters' total CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG, with CRIT DMG capped at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3103004.shortDesc: DoTs taken by enemy targets can CRIT. The CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG is based on all ally characters' total CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG.
3103004.lore:
After the Swarm's remnants invaded, the Twin-Sided Planet had long since been reduced to a planetary ring, sustained only by an ancient Planetary Treadmill Generator. To maintain the ring's energy and momentum, the Twin-Sided Monarch holds the Eternal Sprint every decade: contestants must run the ring nonstop until only the final victor remains. The winner claims the Monarch's promised reward, while those who quit or lose face execution.
The brutal rules bred resentment. During one sprint, all the contestants stopped moving in unison. The Monarch declared the race had no winner, and ordered every last one of them to be beheaded. To this day, wandering Sin Thirsters can always be observed on the ring, still locked in their eternal sprint.

3103005.name: Life Forged By Dice
3103005.description: Increases the "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG taken by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After enemy targets take DoT outside their turn, all allies receive "<u>Blazar</u>" Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their respective ATK. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> times per enemy target per turn.
3103005.shortDesc: Enemy targets take increased "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG. After enemy targets take DoT outside their turn, charge all allies with "<u>Blazar</u>".
3103005.lore:
Every Dicean is born with their own twenty-sided die. On this planet, you roll for everything, and I mean everything. Here's a day in the life:
Tony wakes up and reaches for the curtains. Athletics check: Nat 1. Critical fail. The curtains wrap him up like a spring roll, and he's late for work. His boss calls Tony into the office, and without any points in "Persuasion," he goes for "Brawl" instead, which ends in... success! Security then throws him out. When Tony gets home, he realizes he lost his keys in the scuffle, so he attempts to "Pick Lock." And it's a... critical fail. The door stands up and slaps him twice. Desperate, Tony decides to try "Climb"... Finally, critical success! He spends the night on the cold, cold moon.
Maybe they should try a d<unbreak>100</unbreak> roll, you know?

3103006.name: Foolish King
3103006.description: Increases DoT taken by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After "<u>Dealer</u>" deals DMG, each instance immediately causes all DoT debuffs on the enemy target to deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
3103006.shortDesc: Increases DoT taken by enemy targets. After the "<u>Dealer</u>" deals DMG, triggers DoT.
3103006.lore:
Bow before me! You lowly subjects of Benzaitengoku, I hail from the great nation of Behrenger. Those savages burned it to the ground. Of the entire court, only I, heir to the Wrath King's will, escaped under the cover of mecha-soldiers. I shall be crowned here as the new king. Laughter is civilization's poison. It leads humanity astray, inflates entropy, and speeds the death of worlds. By royal decree, the Great Edict shall rule here now!
Don't mistake my words for empty air. Within the Entropy Restriction Field, all is the domain of your King. Drama shall fall silent, dance shall cease, laughter shall be snuffed out the instant before it escapes your lips, and all foolish acts that hinder entropy reduction shall be locked away in prison.
Call this my declaration of war to Elation itself. From this moment forth, laughter is forbidden in this place.

3103007.name: Ironarm Ranger
3103007.description: Increases "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" max limit by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s). For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of total team Max HP lost by the entire team, all enemies immediately gain 1 stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>."
3103007.shortDesc: The maximum stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" increases. Every time the team loses a certain amount of HP, they gain "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>."
3103007.lore:
"An interview? Phew, that was close! That runaway car almost smashed into that mother and daughter on the sidewalk. Good thing I was quick on the draw, I rushed over and swept them both out of harm's way. Just another day bringing justice to the streets!"
Ironarm Ranger, a self-proclaimed superhero who frequently appears at accident scenes with the intention of saving lives, but often makes things worse. The mother and daughter he "rescued" suffered spinal fractures, the car he pushed out of the mud pit fell apart on the spot, and the person he caught falling from a building ended up broken into three pieces... After he became a Supplicant, the accident rate in Planarcadia skyrocketed.
"No need to thank me, just doing what any hero would do. I'll keep doing what's right. Remember the name: Ironarm Ranger."

3103008.name: Comet Handler
3103008.description: For every 1% of CRIT Rate that exceeds <unbreak>100%</unbreak> for the ally target and the "<u>Dealer</u>," CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After ally targets launch an attack, increases the CRIT Rate of this unit and the "<u>Dealer</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stacks.
