If it is a Follow-Up ATK, it can additionally stack <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3103008.shortDesc: For every 1% of CRIT Rate that exceeds <unbreak>100%</unbreak> for the ally target and the "<u>Dealer</u>," CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After an ally target launches an attack, increases the CRIT Rate of this unit and the "<u>Dealer</u>," with Follow-Up ATKs providing an additional increase.
3103008.lore:
The segmentum where Planet Mio resides is pure chaos. A comet called "the Intruder" is always zooming around all over the place, constantly overlapping with Mio's orbit and threatening to crash into it. One time, as it approached Mio's atmosphere, someone on the planet cracked a joke that made the comet chuckle, causing it to lose its orbital trajectory. Just like that, an apocalyptic crisis passed Myo by. People realized: This star had a pretty low bar for humor.
Nowadays, whenever people on Mio spot "the Intruder" coming, they all start telling jokes to make it laugh and veer off course. Mio scientists are even trying to develop joke-powered propulsion to steer the comet in designated directions.

3103009.name: Meteor Wholesaler
3103009.description: For every 1% of action advance effect gained by ally targets, additionally deals True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG dealt after using an attack in the next turn, up to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of True DMG. Additionally deals True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG when in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state.
3103009.shortDesc: After an ally target gains any action advance effects, they additionally deal more True DMG after attacking in their next turn. While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, further increases the True DMG dealt.
3103009.lore:
Good news for all you wish-makers out there! I'm officially launching my meteor shower wholesale service today. Just bring your own materials: junked cars, busted furniture, whatever, I'll take it all. For just a teensy bit of Wishpower, you can watch 'em streak across the sky and rain down on this planet as shooting stars.
Just so we're clear: I only accept non-living items. Like that time when certain people sent over rival mob members, or when the lab tried to dump mutant worms on me. Yeah, I sent those right back where they came from, untouched.
Also, I don't accept anything over a hundred cubic meters. Last time someone asked me to toss a building that was about to be demolished, and I nearly got my Supplicant status revoked because it triggered an earthquake.

3103010.name: Frost Giant
3103010.description: When an ally target takes DMG or consumes HP while their HP percentage is less than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Obsession</u>" from the target with the highest "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks in the team, heals for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of this unit's Max HP, and increases DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). This effect can only be triggered <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per turn.
3103010.shortDesc: While HP percentage is less than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, consumes "<u>Obsession</u>" from the ally target with the highest "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks in the team to restore HP and increase DMG dealt.
3103010.lore:
Fear me, fiends from beyond, though it matters not. I am the titan of frost and ice, the embodiment of calamity, humanity's most bone-deep memory of winter's wrath. I am an Aberration born of imagenesis, my bones forged from eternal snow, my soul a roiling storm of endless rage. With one hand I topple mountains; with the other, I summon storm clouds. I shatter the earth and cast armies into the abyss; I hurl down blizzards and seal monsters in frozen tombs.
Fear me, fiends from beyond. When you lay eyes on me, your fate is already sealed. My brothers and sisters are unmatched. You wield flames that consume the cosmos? We command the might to freeze entire worlds. It is not Ahatopia that faces extinction, but you. Come, then, monster to monster. Let us play a little game... of snowballs.

3103011.name: Aberration Idol
3103011.description: Increases "<u>Blazar</u>" Charging Efficiency by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state is active, using Basic ATK/Skills to perform attacks deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG to the target.
3103011.shortDesc: Increases the Charging Efficiency of "<u>Blazar</u>." After attacking via using Basic ATK/Skill while in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, deals "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG to the target.
3103011.lore:
Ever heard of Mareray Not-Spicy? Yeah, the monster from that movie, one of *Arcadia's Ten Most Terrifying Characters*. Well, here's some bad news: it's alive.
Recently, there's been this late-night livestream channel, and the streamer is called Mareray Not-Spicy. It's all footage of random Aberration attacks, so thrilling. It's said the Department of Aberration Defense tried to ban it, but the monster's already become a Supplicant, so they had to let it slide.
Oh, you're saying you're a longtime subscriber? That's terrible. Word is, the targets those Aberrations hunt are actually randomly selected from the subscribed viewers. You can still unsubscribe if you want.
...Wait, you're actually unsubscribing?
Well then, looks like tonight's stream is getting moved up.

3103012.name: Divine Retribution Voting Device
3103012.description: When ally targets Break any enemy target's Weakness, Charge "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP and Shield. If all enemy targets are Weakness Broken, "<u>Blazar</u>" will not be cleared at the end of ally targets' turns.
3103012.shortDesc: When Breaking Weakness, charges "<u>Blazar</u>." If all enemy targets are Weakness Broken, "<u>Blazar</u>" will not be cleared at the end of an ally target's turn.
3103012.lore:
Hello, welcome to today's Divine Penalty voting site. Based on the weight on Taggel, select ten sentient beings on this planet you most wish to see punished by Divine Penalty. If you choose to abstain, you will automatically receive <unbreak>10</unbreak> votes. For the sake of everyone's happiness, all evil must be eradicated.
Think carefully. Who do you despise most? Who do you hate most? Who's the most wicked, the most corrupt? Your enemies, your romantic rivals, your political opponents... Who bumped into you at the subway station yesterday without saying sorry? No running away! No dodging! These are the rules you set up. You created me to escape responsibility. You created me to bear your malice. Close your eyes in darkness, for the Divine Penalty will never end.

3103013.name: Truly Fortunate Chess
3103013.description: For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Charge on the "<u>Dealer</u>," gains 1 additional Hit Per Action. When a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> ally targets are attacked, the "<u>Dealer</u>" gains 1 point of Charge.
3103013.shortDesc: For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Charge on the "<u>Dealer</u>," gains 1 additional Hit Per Action. When multiple ally targets are attacked, the "<u>Dealer</u>" gains 1 point of Charge.
3103013.lore:
Let's play a round of Yumanji, the game of the brave, where disputes and judgments of Fools can all be decided by its roll. Pull the board from your Wondrous Pocket, stake each other's masks, let the dice fall, and leave the stories and narrative rights to Aha.
Advance 3 spaces, alcohol undergoes fusion reaction within the glass. Advance 6 spaces, poetry spills across the floor and trips pedestrians. Move back 1 space, worms burrow out of phone booths. Advance 4 spaces, rain from the sky turns into octopuses. The story spreads and corrupts, making reality distorted and matter unstable. Don't die, don't be afraid, for the bigger the chaos, the better the fun.
Oh, and don't stop this sacred game midway. Aha's punishments are far more random than the rewards.

3103014.name: Aether Hacker
3103014.description: Increases ally targets' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using an Ultimate or Elation Skill to defeat an enemy target, records overflow DMG. The next <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> attack(s) will deal additional DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the recorded value to a random attack target.
3103014.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' CRIT DMG. After using an Ultimate or Elation Skill to defeat an enemy target, records overflow DMG. The next <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> attack(s) will deal additional DMG equal a certain percentage of the recorded value to a random attack target.
3103014.lore:
Ever since the arcadia returned to reality, hackers have been flocking to this place. I wove traps throughout the space, laid countless schemes, and snatched this mask from those losers. What am I here for? Same as the old-timers, I'm here to play a game.
Rumor has it Aha once wove the "End of the World" from a single poem. Probably just a joke, of course. Following the flow of data, we craft cartridges, weaving the silk of reality like spiders spinning destiny. I can build a spaceship out of a joke, or code a deletion program into a one-button bomb. Victory is a player's calling, and who could refuse a game crafted by an Aeon?
I'll admit I lost this round, but no matter, there'll always be more hackers coming back here.

3103015.name: Fabulist of the Stars
3103015.description: When "<u>Dealer</u>" deals DMG, ignores Weakness Type and reduces the enemy target's Toughness by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> points. This Toughness Reduction can at most reduce the enemy to 1 point of Toughness. When an enemy target's Weakness is Broken, for every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points of Max Toughness, they receive <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> more DMG for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3103015.shortDesc: "<u>Dealer</u>" ignores Weakness Type when reducing Toughness while dealing DMG. When an enemy target's Weakness is Broken, increases DMG taken based on Max Toughness.
3103015.lore:
Who is it that tells the fables? The ancient past, the vibrant present, and the fleeting future moments. The Fabulist walks upon the earth, passing through fields of flowers, and butterflies flutter toward him. He strolls along the shore, and fish splash their tails in agreement. In an age before the imagenae were even born, sprites of faint wisdom hid behind stones, secretly following, while birds carried away the seeds of stories, spreading them to countless homes.
The Fabulist walks farther and farther, his audience growing ever larger behind him. He set out from the ancient tree, journeying forward, only to return from the other end of the world. And so, all the living beings of the world gather around the storyteller, listening intently to myths and legends from the stars.

3103016.name: Impoverished Kidnapper
3103016.description: The True DMG multiplier of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier and increases attack count by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. After a memosprite uses an attack, they can trigger the True DMG of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" and consume its attack count.
3103016.shortDesc: Increases the True DMG dealt by "<u>Butterfly Soul.</u>" Memosprites' attacks will additionally apply True DMG from "<u>Butterfly Soul.</u>"
3103016.lore:
Friends, do you remember the last Phantasmoon Games? To escape the stellar storm from the Consternation Starzone, the beautiful Supplicant Miss Azalea turned us into earthworms and made us burrow underground.
Down there, I remembered my sweet childhood... Back then, the world was small, and there were only a few things worth caring about. Just like when you're an earthworm, all you need to think about is how to eat dirt.
How I wish to be an earthworm again! It is so peaceful underground, and the soil is so delicious. Being an earthworm is way more fun than being human!
Now recruiting kind souls to help me kidnap Miss Azalea and force her to turn us back into earthworms. If she refuses, we'll eat dirt in public. She'll definitely agree! Team Progress: 3/<unbreak>9999</unbreak>

3103017.name: Hero of Dejection
3103017.description: Every time an enemy target takes 1 instance of DoT, Charges "Soul Chrysalis" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. If currently in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Stacks up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) and lasts until exiting the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state.
3103017.shortDesc: Every time an enemy target takes 1 instance of DoT, Charges "Soul Chrysalis" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. If currently in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Stacks up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) and lasts until exiting the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state.
3103017.lore:
After his name was called, a visible aura of dejection began radiating from Supplicant Caspar. Individuals exposed to this dejection experienced unstable emotions. Close monitoring of Caspar's movements is deemed necessary.
2:<unbreak>45</unbreak> PM, Caspar entered the subway station, attempting to board the train. All trains, including the Bullet Wyrm express, ceased operations due to loss of motivation.
2:<unbreak>50</unbreak> PM, Caspar returned to the surface and began traveling on foot. Shops along the route started closing one after another.
2:<unbreak>55</unbreak> PM, Caspar suspected to be a Self-Annihilator.
3:<unbreak>20</unbreak> PM, Caspar arrived at Duomension City Central Plaza. The crowd collectively lay down and gave up.
3:<unbreak>45</unbreak> PM, Caspar has been taken into custody by the Security Bureau, but the number of individuals affected by the dejection continues to rise. Suspected to possess memetic properties.
4:<unbreak>15</unbreak> PM, I've decided to quit. Life is meaningless anyway, so why should I be stuck in this boring job.

3103018.name: Imperial Sting
3103018.description: When ally target enters "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, used Ultimate also deals "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>"'s True DMG, and increases "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>"'s attack count by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>. This effect triggers up to 1 time for each ally.
3103018.shortDesc: After ally targets enter "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, using Ultimate also deals "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" True DMG and increases "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" attack count.
3103018.lore:
"Please, don't be afraid. I personally incubated every single one of these Stings. Sure, they look different, have distinct genes, but each has undergone rigorous training. They won't hurt you."
"Don't give me that look of disgust. Compared to the backstabbing, scheming human society, my Stings here are loyal and devoted like brothers in arms, every one of them. If you ask me, these little guys are the most charming creatures in the universe. The Imperator Insectorum's calamity left behind too much prejudice, but mark my words, one day, everyone will come to love Stings."
"Supplicant? No, no, no. The mask means nothing to me. But care to guess whose hands I placed it in?" The man patted the shoulder of the humanoid giant insect beside him, earning a buzzing sound of delight in response.

3103019.name: Mage of Ruins
3103019.description: After a memosprite uses an attack, Charge their memomaster's "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After the memomaster uses "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" to use their Ultimate, increases the memosprite's DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3103019.shortDesc: After a memosprite attacks, Charges their memomaster's "<u>Brain in a Vat.</u>" After a memomaster uses their Ultimate via "<u>Brain in a Vat,</u>" increases their memosprite's DMG.
3103019.lore:
I've told you already. I don't like kids. Planarcadia is such a backwater place. Magic is precious, not some party trick for you to mess around with. Want to learn it? Well, tough luck. The curse of Elris originated from the Reality Modification Device's explosion. Fragments of ancient ruins embedded themselves into our genes.
I can conjure endless winds to sweep across the hills, summon brilliant light to illuminate the night sky, or evaporate lakes with searing fireballs. Of course, everything has a price. Ancient wisdom put a stop to greed, so there's a limit to how many spells you can remember. Exceed it, and they'll be forgotten. Are you even listening? Well, I'll do this candy trick just one more time, okay? Do you have any idea how wasteful this is? My ability bar can only hold three spells at once.

3103020.name: IQ Tax Collector
3103020.description: Ally targets' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using ATKs that deal Ultimate DMG, causes the "<u>Murmur</u>" on the attack target to deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of original DMG.
3103020.shortDesc: Increases ATK. After using attacks to deal Ultimate DMG, triggers "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG.
3103020.lore:
Dear dimwits, don't feel down about your own ignorance. Why should only geniuses and smart people get respect? Intelligence is something you're born with, so it's not your fault you don't have it.
So, I'm going to break this intellectual monopoly by imposing an "IQ Tax" on this planet. See this round, chubby machine next to me? It'll release a global stupidity wave that'll bring everyone's IQ down to the same level.
All you smarty-pants out there, feeling a bit forgetful lately? Questions that used to be a piece of cake now making you scratch your heads? Time for you to experience what the dummies go through! And as for you dimwits, soon you'll be able to use your rich experience to beat those former geniuses.
I'm Supplicant Smarty Head, that's my name on the roll-call. Thank you, everyone.

3103021.name: Super Jock
3103021.description: When any ally target Breaks any enemy target's Weakness, Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and regenerates Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy. After defeating any enemy target, regenerates Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy.
3103021.shortDesc: When Breaking enemy targets' Weakness, Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" and regenerates Energy. After any enemy target is defeated, regenerates Energy.
3103021.lore:
Doramon boasts an incredibly advanced education system. Kids there master calculus by age 6, get cozy with string theory by 8, and can hand-calculate black hole gravity formulas by <unbreak>10</unbreak>, which explains why the "Knowledge Injection Gun" became such a massive hit on that planet. To prevent students from turning into total bookworms, the Doramon Ministry of Education mandated that every child must launch a lead ball equal to their own body weight during their coming-of-age ceremony. Method doesn't matter; just get it done. But as the academic rat race heated up, kids started hurling those balls faster and faster, until they broke the first cosmic velocity.
Now, the planet's low orbit is completely crammed with lead balls floating around like a makeshift asteroid belt, so the coming-of-age ritual got an upgrade: it's now an obstacle course in space. Kids pilot manual spacecraft through the shot put field, and a little bit later, they will be scattered by the crowd.

3103022.name: Song of Gravity
3103022.description: When enemy targets take "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG, additionally take 1 instance of "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG. Every debuff currently on the target additionally increases this DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3103022.shortDesc: "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG is triggered 1 more time. This DMG increases with the number of debuffs afflicted on the enemy target.
3103022.lore:
I consider myself an anthropologist, so I chose to observe Tailitrace, an inhabited planet near a black hole. Due to tidal forces, every astronaut sent into its gravitational field must bid farewell to their family forever, and the people of Tailitrace hold a song festival to see them off.
This is the grandest celebration on the planet. Young and old, men and women alike come to sing and rate each other's songs. The winner is chosen as the next astronaut, and their prize is this song: the voice of the first singer is stretched by gravity at the edge of the black hole, physically layering and interweaving with the voice of the later singer, creating a time-dilated chorus. Only those who enter the black hole's range can hear the complete song.
I can't imagine how mesmerizing that melody must be. Perhaps I should go listen for myself.

3103023.name: Master of Fates
3103023.description: After any ally target attacks a Weakness Broken enemy target, converts the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>. For each stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" inflicted on an enemy target, this effect additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
3103023.shortDesc: After ally targets attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, deal <u>Super Break DMG</u>. The higher the number of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" stacks on enemy targets, the higher this <u>Super Break DMG</u> will be.
3103023.lore:
I'm a Papu, and right now I'm freaking out big time. Just moments ago, I was one of a hundred unlucky saps randomly selected to become a "Master of Fates." By the end of today, any other Papu can take our lives, no questions asked, and face zero legal consequences.
Honestly, I have no idea what's so fun about this game, though I'll admit I enjoyed playing it myself in the past. Supposedly, the souls of "Masters of Fates" please Aha. I really want to tell THEM that I'm a person with absolutely zero sense of humor, not like my cubicle neighbor, whose puns always crack up the whole office. Take him instead, please.
I know thinking about this is pointless, but it's just a way to distract myself, because the banging and clanging outside is making my scalp crawl. Aeons know what kind of abuse that security door is enduring right now. I can only pray it holds out until midnight, or else I'll end up just like that door.

3103024.name: Man, Serpent, Astral Ring
3103024.description: When an enemy target's turn begins while Weakness Broken, they take 1 additional instance of "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of its original DMG. Each time an ally target uses their Ultimate, increases the "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of its original DMG.
3103024.shortDesc: When an enemy target's turn begins while Weakness Broken, they take 1 additional instance of "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG. Each time an ally target uses their Ultimate, "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG is increased.
3103024.lore:
Give me your weary
Your sorrowful
Your dejected
Those who lift their heads yearning for unbridled smiles
Those abandoned by this land of Elation, bereft of fun, faces heavy with gloom
Give them to me
Let one rest their hands upon my shoulders
Then let another rest their hands upon theirs
We touch one another, letting Elation circulate through every organ in our bodies
We form a serpent, spreading laughter and joy through every street and alley of the arcadia
Every human we meet along the way, every imagenae, will join our procession
We are like a ravenous python, never tiring, never sated
Until at last we connect head to tail around that Phantasmoon, becoming its crystalline astral ring

3103025.name: Fire and Dangerous Things
3103025.description: When an ally target uses their Ultimate via "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," gains 1 stack of "Lucidity": Increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and the memosprite's CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3103025.shortDesc: When an ally target uses their Ultimate via "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," increases this unit's and their memosprite's CRIT DMG.
3103025.lore:
If one can't blast open a hatch with a shotgun the way you do, squeeze through a narrow duct without their claustrophobia kicking in, and then crank out a hundred and twenty pull-ups inside a wrecked space pod, then they don't get to call themselves a scholar of the Armed Archaeologists. The Intelligentsia Guild's survey satellites once scattered across deep space like dandelion seeds. Now all that's left is the salvage waiting to be recovered in these ruins before you. The cold light of a glow stick cuts through the darkness, revealing sand and stone layered like scabs over the aluminum dome. Crude murals record the last hunt: fire, flint, bows, humans, altars, and spilled blood.

You can see it all unfolding in your mind: Over twenty generations, they lost their coordinates first, then their supplies, then their writing, then their speech. Faith in the stars devolved into a game of the hunter and the hunted. Out in the wilderness of space, the capsule became humanity's final cave.

You feel a little at a loss with this artifact.

3103026.name: Bucktaker
3103026.description: Increases ally targets' Weakness Break Efficiency by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Breaking an enemy target's Weakness, increases the clearance threshold of "<u>Murmur</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and immediately causes this target's "<u>Murmur</u>" to reach the clearance threshold. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time per enemy target for the whole battle.
3103026.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' Weakness Break Efficiency. After Weakness Breaking an enemy target, increases the clearance threshold for "<u>Murmur</u>" and immediately causes the target's "<u>Murmur</u>" to reach its clearance threshold.
3103026.lore:
Alright, fine, I admit it's all my fault. I shouldn't have swerved to avoid that speeding car, causing it to slam into a mother and her daughter on the sidewalk. And I shouldn't have dodged that flowerpot either, which, as it turns out, let the Kolchis complete their biological invasion. But I have to clarify: I was just asking for directions, and I didn't recognize some intergalactic fugitive. He's the one who decided to blow himself up. And I didn't mean to destroy the Duomension City station at all. I don't know anything about "resonance," and I still don't understand how a few steps I took to catch the subway could bring down an entire building.

No matter how you blame me, I'm not leaving the arcadia. Who else is going to absorb all this overwhelming tide of negative Wishpower? You need me, because I'm your scapegoat.

3103027.name: Celestial Mortician
3103027.description: Each stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" additionally deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP. When the number of ally targets on the field changes, for every 1 ally target changed, causes all enemies to gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>."
3103027.shortDesc: Each stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" deals extra DMG. When the number of ally targets currently on the field changes, causes all enemies to gain "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>."
3103027.lore:
Relax. Don't be afraid. Just think of it as me talking to myself. It's the one professional habit I can never break.
Before I joined this pointless contest, I'd handled too many clients: young main sequence stars, cut down in their most ambitious years. Recklessly speeding comets, colliding with another planet in a gravitational accident. And of course, most of them were red giant stars. Old and fading, their dim light rarely enough to cover their tab.
I'd take out their cooling cores with my blade, mend their broken rings with marble, and carve elegies onto their tombstones... All of it gone in the blink of an eye.
Still listening? Here, take my card. Don't let losing to me leave you bitter. I'll offer you a complimentary service as consolation.
Compared to a red giant star, you're really quite small.

3103028.name: Slapman
3103028.description: "<u>Blazar</u>" additionally deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG. For each debuff the enemy target has, "<u>Blazar</u>" additionally deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
3103028.shortDesc: "Blazar" deals extra DMG. For each debuff an enemy target has, "Blazar" deals extra DMG to them.
3103028.lore:
When the black shadow descends upon Ahatopia, and people's minds drown in the hollow waters of emptiness, what they need is a crisp, ringing slap to scatter the nightmare. Um, I know none of you are particularly fond of me. After all, my methods have always been a bit rough. But I believe what this wretched world needs most is a good slap.
Can't find meaning in existence, so you run around causing chaos? A slap will fix that. Always lost in delusion, never grounded? One slap. A Self-Annihilator? Slap. A Doctors of Chaos? Slap. The real tragedy is that too many people need a slap, and I've only got two hands. Yep, everyone deserves a fair share of slaps. Even that moon up there.

3103029.name: The Wellerman
3103029.description: Increases ally targets' SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and Elation by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After their action is cumulatively advanced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, extends the duration of their "Certified Banger" by 1 turn.
3103029.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' SPD and Elation. After receiving action advances a certain number of times, extends the duration of "Certified Banger."
3103029.lore:
There once was a Fool's ship that put to sea, and the name of the ship was Wellerman, gee.
Whenever the Wellerman rode the gale, no troubles will prevail.

Actors and jesters upon her stern,
And candy and games at every turn.
Her bow cuts a path through the Imaginary sea,
And leaves all the stars shining wild and free.

Just give seven shrieks and hop in the air,
Dance to the evening star right there,
The Wellerman will receive the signal flare.
Thanks to The Laughter guiding the way,
Though trapped at the black hole's edge we stay,
She'll bring you back safe to the bay.

So fear you not, young sailor bold,
Though we have lost our way untold.
Whenever the Wellerman rode the gale,
No troubles will prevail.

3103030.name: Disastrous Baker
3103030.description: Increases the max limit of "<u>Blazar</u>" by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the current Shield Effect. After an ally target uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains a Shield equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3103030.shortDesc: "<u>Blazar</u>" limit increases based on the current Shield Effect. After ally target uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains a Shield.
3103030.lore:
My ol' master always used to tell me: "You ain't bakin' cakes. You're bakin' mistakes!"

But nah, I don't buy it. I've gotta have some kind of talent, right? Look at that "Gentleman Soufflé," fresh out of the oven and it's already helping grandmas cross the street. Too bad it's got no eyes. And that "Conscience Croissant"? Any thief who gets a whiff drops dead on the spot from lack of conscience. Oh, and I almost forgot the "True Love Madeleine." That one's the real test of a couple's love. If you turn into a cake and they don't eat you? Not true love.

Ah, enough of that. I've done pretty well for myself, but I still just wanna bake a proper cake. A plain ol' cake, the kind that makes you hum after the first bite. And till I get it right, this ol' oven ain't ever gonna stop.

3103031.name: Brainiac Feud
3103031.description: Increases ally targets' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When an ally uses their Ultimate, advances the action of "<u>Dealer</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). The trigger count resets after "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action.
3103031.shortDesc: Increases ally target's CRIT DMG. When using Ultimate, advances the action of "<u>Dealer</u>."
3103031.lore:
Q: Brainiac Feud, where the smartest minds make the biggest splash! Welcome to the most electrifying rapid-fire quiz show in the cosmos, *Brainiac Feud*!
A: Who the ████ are you?
Q: Here's your question: How much did the Grand Chancellor embezzle in total? A. <unbreak>1,000,000</unbreak> Kingdom Credits. B. <unbreak>50,000,000</unbreak> Kingdom Credits...
A: Guards! Guards!
Q: Wrong answer! Next question. What was the cause of death for the guards? A. Excessive blood loss. B. Death by shock. C. Brainiac Feud.
A: ...
Q: Wrong answer! Next question! What was the cause of death for the Grand Chancellor? A. Death by shock. B. Death by shock. C. Death by shock.
A: Just WHO the ████ are you!?
Q: Final question! Who was the champion of the Riddle Kingdom's inaugural *Brainiac Feud*? A. Riddle King Salsahut! B. Riddle King Salsahut!! C. Riddle King Salsahut!!!

3103032.name: Dearest Scolopendra
3103032.description: During "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," Break DMG dealt by ally targets increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Each time an enemy target is Broken, charges "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> after "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" ends.
3103032.shortDesc: Increases ally target's Break DMG dealt during "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>." Every time an enemy target is Broken, charges "<u>Soul Chrysalis</u>" after "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" ends.
3103032.lore:
According to carbon-based lifeform theory, all things will ultimately undergo "carcinization," meaning under the pressure of natural selection, all life will eventually converge on a crab-like form. But this is the foolish doctrine of carbon-based centrism. Broaden your point of view to encompass all life in the universe, and you will find that everything ultimately undergoes "scolopendrization."
Scolopendra, the most beautiful creature in the universe. <unbreak>2,999</unbreak> legs, <unbreak>34,651</unbreak> eyes, laying <unbreak>3,079</unbreak> eggs each year, nurtured and incubated within the spongy dermal layers of its back, emerging from its cocoon after <unbreak>71</unbreak> stellar days. It is the embodiment of prime numbers, a perfect form of life.
But take note, for an entire ecosystem to ultimately "scolopendrize," it requires sustained, immense pressure of natural selection.
And so, in the name of the Elation, I have plunged these worlds into eternal war. This is no crime, but an act of encouraging nature to return, as swiftly as possible, to its most perfect order.

3104001.name: Beautiful Poem
3104001.description: After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, after memosprites use an attack, they can deal the True DMG from "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" without consuming its attack count. The enemy target with the highest Max HP becomes "Encocooned," until you exit "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>." While in this state, all "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" DMG taken by it is recorded. After taking <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> hits/after the target is defeated/when exiting "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the recorded DMG to all enemy targets and clears the recorded value.
3104001.shortDesc: Memosprites can trigger "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>'s" True DMG. The enemy target with the highest Max HP will enter the "Encocoon" state, lasting until exiting "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>." While in this state, all "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" DMG dealt to them is recorded. After receiving a certain number of attacks, or when the target is defeated, or when exiting "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," deals a certain percentage of the recorded DMG to all enemies and clears the recorded value.
3104001.lore:
I am a beautiful poem
A flower blooming within meanings, imagery, and memetic essence
O people of the arcadia
Sing in harmony with me beneath the light of the moon
I have hidden myself within a poem
If you should call my name
I shall pass through words and melodies
Across the tip of your tongue and into your dreams
I have woven the game into a poem
Recite my verses or sing them to the lyre
Offer your heart and your wishes
To this Mask
Then join me in crafting words into a vessel
And sail toward the far shore of the night sky

3104002.name: Apples! Apples!
3104002.description: "Sudden Insight" appears on the Action Order. When taking action, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Ice <u>Base DMG</u> to all enemies and activates the Ultimates of all allies. For every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" possessed by the first character in the team and their memosprite, increases the Base SPD of "Sudden Insight" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> and additionally deals the <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> Ice <u>Base DMG</u> to each enemy target.
3104002.shortDesc: "Sudden Insight" appears in the Action Order. When it takes action, it deals Ice DMG to all enemies and activates all allies' Ultimates. The higher the <u>Obsession</u> stacks of the first character in the team and their memosprite, the higher "Sudden Insight's" SPD and DMG.
3104002.lore:
Ladies and gentlemen, and to the security officers here to apprehend me, I regret to inform you that I have played a little word game with you all. I have stolen the personal pronouns from your minds and replaced them with my favorite fruits. Unlike that chaos in Ternary City, this trick is more elegant and far more entertaining. It is quite simple:
"Apple" = "You"
"Watermelon" = "I"
Looking at the colleagues before you who have turned into "Apples," I'm sure "Apple" are beginning to understand the rules of "Watermelons." Truth be told, I was standing right in front of "Apple" just now, but in the eyes of "Apple," I'm just another "Apple" too. Oh well, what can I say? "Watermelon" am a bit of a riddler after all. Oh, and one more thing: Do not eat any fruit until the Phantasmoon Games are over.

3104003.name: Conceptual Sacrificial Rite
3104003.description: After an enemy target attacks an ally target, "<u>Murmur</u>" obtains Charge equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the clearance threshold "<u>Murmur</u>" charges, the enemy target immediately takes 1 instance of Lightning DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the "<u>Murmur</u>" clearance threshold. Each enemy target can trigger this up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s), and the trigger count resets after any unit's action. This DMG is considered as "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG and cannot defeat the enemy target.
3104003.shortDesc: When an enemy target attacks an ally target, "<u>Murmur</u>" gains Charge. For every set percentage of the "<u>Murmur</u>" clearance threshold Charged, that enemy target immediately takes 1 instance of <u>"Murmur"</u> DMG.
3104003.lore:
This was my first time attending a sacrificial ceremony on Planet Devor. Hundreds of thousands sat in circles around a pitch black abyss, around which the atmosphere was solemn and reverent. "Embodiments of concepts" were sealed in black boxes and carried to the edge amidst the flickering glow of LEDs.
Sorrow, bonfires, herbs, an eight-eyed beast, a single phoneme... One concept after another was cast into the abyss, vanishing from Planet Devor forever. No one knows whether their disappearance was a voluntary act of the people, or if they were erased by some transcendent power the moment they plunged into the darkness.
The priest meticulously climbed the altar and pushed the offerings into the bottomless darkness, while onlookers remained silent. Yet a question surfaced in my mind: what would happen if I were to jump down from here?

3104004.name: Soul Returner
3104004.description: After ally targets use Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, "<u>Murmur</u>" deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG multiplier to adjacent targets. DMG dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>" then additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> every time an Ultimate is used.
3104004.shortDesc: After ally targets use Ultimates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) in total, "<u>Murmur</u>" dealts DMG to adjacent targets. Then, DMG dealt by "<u>Murmur</u>" increases for every time an Ultimate is used.
3104004.lore:
How pitiful the universe is, that people die without dignity, and then vanish into nothingness. You once sang in the gondola, reciting decayed verses from a fallen realm, where people dreamed of an afterlife. In that world, suffering would be rewarded and sins would be tormented. Brief lives would give way to an endless existence, and the world would know no more farewells.
 A future of emptiness is the chronic affliction of the universe. You sang the song of death and invited the shadows of yesteryear to dance: lost children and departed lovers. Cries echoed through Ahatopia while tears gathered into rivers. You ascended to the moon and accepted a fleeting portion of that deity's authority.
 You said, "There should be another realm beyond death." And then, the universe made your words come true.

3104005.name: Street Rider Officer
3104005.description: After all allies cumulatively launch <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> attacks, the first character in the current team gains an extra turn. The attack count taken into account by Follow-Up ATKs is doubled. After using an attack in this extra turn, deals Additional DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of ATK to the attack target. Every stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" allies possess increases this DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original multiplier.
3104005.shortDesc: After the ally team launches a certain number of attacks, the first character in the current team gains an extra turn and deals DMG based on "<u>Obsession</u>" stacks after attacking.
3104005.lore:
In Planarcadia, even streets die in silence, taking with them childhood soda bottles and street vendors' calls as they are swallowed by the neon lights of a glitzy world. But in Planarcadia, death itself is livelier than anything beyond the sky. The ghosts of streets sprout eyes and thousands of legs, drifting through reality like urban legends. You might encounter one inside a skyscraper or discover a bustling, ancient alleyway hidden in a forest, where crudely made masks and sweets are sold.
The streets never vanished. They are like giant serpents, and I am a soul left behind in the past, driving them as they weave through the city. We grapple with skyscrapers and spar with commercial districts. Join us! Let us occupy every corner of the arcadia until the streets of the past are resurrected in the present.

3104006.name: Exorcist
3104006.description: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, increases the DMG dealt by ally targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using an attack, if the enemy target's current HP is lower than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP, deals "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" DMG equal to a set amount of their current HP and recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s).
3104006.shortDesc: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, increases DMG dealt by ally targets. Additionally, they can immediately defeat enemies with HP lower than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP, and recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s).
3104006.lore:
You trace the trail of the Aberration through the canvas. A stench extends from the town into the forest, leaving dark ink stains upon the green backdrop. You recall the teachings of your grandfather, Lumirae, on how to subdue an Aberration: you must first see through the cause of its birth. You sweep your brush to paint a path through the forest, letting a strand of pure moonlight flow along it as you follow the scent of evil.
The monster born from the tender fears of a child towers higher than mountains, possessing a human head upon a bestial body. You paint hawks to peck out its eyes and sketch ropes to bind its form. Then, with a light touch of your brush, you ride a coiling Bullet Wyrm to bite through its neck.
Under the Phantasmoon, the creature dissolves into scattered ink. Beneath its remains, you seem to have found something... A blank mask.

3104007.name: Nightmare Lord
3104007.description: After any ally unit is attacked, it is considered as all ally targets have been attacked. All ally targets will Charge "<u>Blazar</u>" equal to the sum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their respective Max HP and Shield.
3104007.shortDesc: After receiving an attack, it is considered as all ally targets having been attacked, and all ally targets will Charge their "<u>Blazar</u>."
3104007.lore:
Repulsive! This planet disgusts me! Inferior phantoms created by Elation wander the land, while mortals are soaked in white noise, consuming credits like swine. Beauty is a virtue of self-awareness and discipline, not this wretched, posturing ugliness. How could those fools who struck me from the Mirror Holders ever understand my rage of disappointment?
Look at yourself in the mirror! Look at the twisted self you ignore and flee from. Behind that radiant smile lies a reality of unbearable suffering. Decaying streets, bitter and wailing monsters, and fragments of the divine reflecting a transcendent city: the deepest fears of every soul are laid bare. Now, I shall unleash the nightmares within the mirror upon reality. To force the world to face its own ugliness, I will gladly shoulder the infamy!

3104008.name: Eternal Supplicant
3104008.description: When the total HP lost by ally targets is equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP or after recovering from being downed, deals DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the max limit of "<u>Harmonize</u>" to all enemies. When a character's turn starts, consumes HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP, increasing this value by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> after every time this effect is triggered. When ally characters become downed for the first time in this battle, restore their current HP to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of their Max HP, and HP will no longer be consumed when their turn starts.
3104008.shortDesc: When accumulating a certain amount of lost HP or recovering from being downed, deals DMG to all enemies based on the max limit of "<u>Harmonize</u>." Characters can resist fatal damage, and consume their HP at the start of every turn before this effect is triggered.
3104008.lore:
You have finally arrived. Have you come to call me to account for my crimes? I was the first to abandon the Phantasmoon Games and keep this mask for myself. As long as the game does not end, the Benediction of Elation shall never cease.
We conquered. We divided the land. We broke the mountains and split the rivers to make Dovebrook. We donned the masks of Fools and borrowed the great power of Aha, yet we styled ourselves as the lords. But what of it? This primitive world gained civilization through us. Those unknown monsters were burned to ash at our whim.
Maintainer of the game, come now. Strike off the head of this rule breaker. But before you do, tell me this: now that all of Ahatopia has fallen into my hands, this world ablaze with light... Is it not stunningly beautiful?

3104009.name: Starlight Bandits
3104009.description: When "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action, increases attack count by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> and changes the attack target to the enemy with the highest current Max HP. When dealing DMG, inflicts <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> additional stack(s) of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" on the target, and after attacking, advances all allies' actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can be triggered at most <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per turn on each enemy target.
3104009.shortDesc: Changes the attack target of "<u>Dealer</u>" to the enemy target with the current highest Max HP, and increases attack count. When dealing DMG, inflicts "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" on the target and advances the actions of all allies.
3104009.lore:
I once stole a star in the Kandea Federation, a gift for a boy. He sat in a desolate village, gazing up at the distant light of a tower's peak. So I reached up, plucked it from the sky, let the tower fall, and made the meteor a gift to the earth.
I once stole a star as repayment for a drink of water, a gift for an old woman in Haloland. Wealth and Knowledge were seized by the magistrate and forged into a brilliant star crowning the world's summit, so I plucked it down, scattered the gold, and let it fall as glittering rain.
Dry your tears for now, child. Let me take down that bright star for you, and at the stronghold of the Demons From Beyond, ignite the first spark to set the land ablaze, so that tragedy will never darken your future again.

3104010.name: Fire Rejectors
3104010.description: When "Pother" appears in the Action Order, each point of <u>Dealer's</u> Charge additionally increases its SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. When "Pother" takes action, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> times. Also Charges "<u>Blazar</u>" by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of each ally target's respective Max HP and current Shield value combined. After each ally unleashes their next attack, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG of a random Type to each of the attack targets.
3104010.shortDesc: When "Pother" appears in the Action Order, its SPD receives an additional bonus based on the number of "<u>Dealer</u>" Charges: When "Pother" takes action, increases DMG dealt by all allies and Charges "<u>Blazar</u>," causing each ally target to deal "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG of a random Type to every attack target after launching their next attack.
3104010.lore:
When the wailing wandered across the scorched earth, a passing man, moved by pity, saved a dying infant girl. She grew up amidst the calamitous flames that engulfed the land, and found her direction through the deaths of countless heroes. She wanted to reach them, to become them, to guard the smiles that should exist beneath the radiance of moon and fire.
The girl left home, no longer naive, no longer weak. Swift and merciless, she brought death to the Legion, and ruin to those who had ravaged the earth. She was the cruelest specter on the battlefield, yet before her comrades, she laughed as bright and clear as the wind chimes. Later, the girl donned a mask and rushed to the final battlefield against the Demons From Beyond. And then... and then...
The ashes scattered on the wind, and nothing of those before remained.

3104011.name: Serpent Slithering
3104011.description: Under the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, each time all allies consume 1 Skill Point, DMG taken by all enemies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, stackable up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state and consuming a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Points for the first time, recover <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> attack count(s) of "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," and before this "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state ends, after ally targets attack, deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG (excluding Additional DMG) to the attack target. This effect also applies to DoT taken by enemy targets at the start of their turn.
3104011.shortDesc: While in the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, the more Skill Points consumed by all allies, the higher the DMG dealt to all enemies. After entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state and consuming a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Points for the first time in that state, recover "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" count(s) and enable attacks and DoT to deal additional True DMG.
3104011.lore:
No one knows why destiny adorned a formless being with a mask. No one knows what face it bore when it still possessed sentience. It moves through the city's underbelly on instinct alone, through sewers, through shadows cast by alleyways, through fragments of paintings. Until one day, it has silently devoured too much flesh and blood, and hunger drives it from its nest.
They rush laughing toward the hundred-eyed, hundred-legged serpent, embracing it, sleeping alongside it. And so, they too become part of the hundred eyes and hundred legs, causing the thoughts of all who meet its gaze to collapse, dissolving into mirages of raw, ravenous desire. The human-faced serpent slithers through the streets, coiling before you. Some memory etched deep within your genes seems to stir... but none of it matters anymore.

3104012.name: Galactic Grand Lotto
3104012.description: For every 1 consumed or overflowing Skill point of ally targets, obtain 1 prize draw chance, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). When entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, summons "Lottery Machine" and consumes all prize draw chances to obtain prizes, with a base draw of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). There is a small chance of obtaining the Special Prize, which deals 1 instance of DMG of a random Type equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> to all enemy targets and gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Charge for the "<u>Dealer</u>." The Consolation Prize deals 1 instance of DMG of a random Type equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> to random enemy targets.
3104012.shortDesc: For every 1 Skill Point consumed or overflowed by ally targets, obtain 1 prize draw chance. When entering the "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>" state, summons the "Lottery Machine" and consumes all prize draw chances to obtain prizes. There is a small chance of obtaining the Special Prize: Deals DMG of a random Type to all enemies and grants <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Charge to the "<u>Dealer</u>." Consolation Prize: Deals DMG of a random Type to a random enemy target.
3104012.lore:
Compared to the Abelane Galaxy Lottery, the Cosmic Big Lotto is total small fry. The Abelaneans claim to have received the Numinosity from Aha: Every eight months, they randomly select one resident of the galaxy and turn them into a millionaire on drawing day. The money appears as if from thin air. The wildest case on record is where one winner walked away with half the wealth of an entire planet.
But this windfall doesn't come without strings attached: Before the next drawing, the previous winner must spend every last credit of their prize money, or they themselves become part of the jackpot. And when the richest person on the planet is desperate to burn cash, how bad could Abelane's economy possibly be?

3104013.name: Useful Scholar
3104013.description: After "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) while no allies in the team are in the "Overclock" state, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). Then, grants the first character in the current team the "Overclock" state: activates their Ultimate and Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This state ends after using Ultimate <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). When triggered for the first time, "<u>Dealer</u>" only needs to take action <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3104013.shortDesc: After the "<u>Dealer</u>" takes action <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> times when no allies are in the "Overclock" state, increases all allies' CRIT DMG and grants the first character in the current team the "Overclock" state: Activates their Ultimate and Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. When triggered for the first time, the "<u>Dealer</u>" only needs to take action <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3104013.lore:
Everyone calls me the Useless Scholar. Well, look who's actually useful today.
This is my anti-addiction combat phone case. Gotta beat it in hand-to-hand combat just to unlock my phone. Might've cranked the difficulty a bit too high, though... Maybe I should just call it the Humanoid Self-Propelled Tank? No worries, I've got another phone! This one syncs with my brain and fires off these ridiculously flashy light waves to broadcast my mental state in real time. Look at them all, crowding around my exhibit. Beats rotting away in the Intelligentsia Guild any day.
What? The Phantasmoon Games is over? Eh, I just stumbled upon this thing anyway. Come on, keep the compliments coming, don't stop now!

3104014.name: Appliance Druid
3104014.description: "Giant Turtle's Breath" with a SPD of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> appears in Action Order: When taking action, increases DMG taken by all enemies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> turns, dealing Ice and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u>, delays their actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, and reduces <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Toughness from all enemy targets ignoring Weakness Type. When Weakness Break occurs on an enemy, triggers both Ice and Fire Weakness Break effects. When ally target activates Ultimate with "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," "Giant Turtle's Breath's" SPD increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> that can stack up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak></color> times.
3104014.shortDesc: "Giant Turtle's Breath" appears in Action Order. When taking action, increases the DMG taken by all enemies, deals Ice and Fire DMG to all enemies, delays their actions, and reduces Toughness from all enemy targets while ignoring Weakness Type. If Weakness Break occurs, triggers both Ice and Fire Weakness Break effects. When ally target activates Ultimate with "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>," "Giant Turtle's Breath's" SPD increases.
3104014.lore:
Marching toward us is the refrigerator, air conditioner, and electric water heater squadron. Don't ask why they've sprouted arms and legs. The point is, they're protesting humanity's overuse. Right behind them, the computer, phone, and digital watch brigade, bouncing and hopping through their chaotic formation like birds on a sugar rush.
Leading this army of appliances is the druid, tinfoil cloak, pot-lid helmet, a tablet face glowing where his mask should be. He hums a tune, like the Pied Piper from ancient fables. In ages long past, Phantasmoon breathed life into all things. And today, the "residents" of this concrete jungle get a taste of that same spark, inviting you and me to join them in a dance.

3104015.name: Dead General
3104015.description: When an enemy target is in the Weakness Broken state, "<u>Harmonize</u>" gains additional effects based on the Types of ally characters in the team. Effects of the same type can stack: Wind, Lightning, Physical: Gains the "Stormheave" effect. When attacked, enemy targets immediately take DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG from the DoT currently inflicted on them. Fire: Gains the "Moltflare" effect. Increases <u>Super Break DMG</u> taken by enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>. Quantum, Imaginary, Ice: Gains the "Intimidation" effect. Enemy target's action is delayed by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>. When attacked, triggers "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) at a rate of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.
3104015.shortDesc: When an enemy target is in the Weakness Break state, "<u>Harmonize</u>" gains additional effects based on the Types of ally characters in the team: Wind, Lightning, Physical: Gains the "Stormheave" effect. Triggers DoT after being attacked. Fire: Gains the "Moltflare" effect. <u>Super Break DMG</u> taken increases. Quantum, Imaginary, Ice: Gains the "Intimidation" effect. Enemy action is delayed, and additionally takes "<u>Harmonize</u>" DMG after being attacked.
3104015.lore:
So you finally show yourself, Demon Lord From Beyond... Do you recognize these faces? The countless souls you slaughtered. Their last cries soaked into this land overflowing with resentment, drinking deep of matter and Wishpower to take form as the lingering sighs of the living. The dead should fade away, but my cursed memory, along with this mask I stumbled upon, became their anchor to this world.
Warriors in life, denied peace even in death. This Legion of vengeance screams and howls in my ears every night. Even ground to dust, they'll take the Devil's head. Rubymoon, Candel, Lentz, Lynn... one hundred and one thousand, two hundred and one names in total. And they're coming for yours.
Comrades, don't rush. When Phantasmoon sets, I'll join you.

3104016.name: Summoner of God
3104016.description: Increases ally targets' SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using an attack, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> fixed chance to add 1 Weakness of a random Type to a random attack target and deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of <u>base DMG</u> of the corresponding Type to them and is guaranteed to trigger if the attack is a Follow-Up ATK. The added Type Weakness is removed after the enemy target is Weakness Broken. After adding a Weakness to an enemy target, records the added Weakness once. This effect can trigger up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per action. When any enemy target is Weakness Broken, based on the recorded Weaknesses, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Break DMG of the corresponding Type for each record to the target and adjacent targets.
3104016.shortDesc: Increases ally targets' SPD. After using an attack, there is a chance to add Weaknesses and deals DMG of corresponding Type to them. If the attack is a Follow-Up ATK, the effect is guaranteed to trigger. Records the Weakness added to enemy targets. When inflicting Weakness Break on enemy targets, deals Break DMG of corresponding Type to the enemy target and adjacent targets based on recorded Weaknesses.
3104016.lore:
Aha? What even is Aha? Calls THEMSELF the ultimate source of fun in the universe, but all THEY bring is cosmic chaos. My homeworld was wrecked by some godforsaken dice game just like that. Far as I'm concerned, all "fun" is just the mocker glad they're not the one getting mocked. Even Aha, there's gotta be words that make THEM lose it.
This is my Revenge! Watch closely, everyone. Starting now, I'm cursing every one of Aha's nine billion names! From the baby name THEY cried at birth to their smuggest, slimiest titles, I'll drag every dirty deed out into the light. Look at that crowd go wild, see that, Aha? That's how much everyone hates you!
Come on, curse the god of Elation with me. One of these insults is bound to sting.

3104017.name: Granny Big Nose
3104017.description: "<u>Dealer</u>"'s Hits Per Action increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>. Each time they deal DMG, grants 1 stack of "Deck Cut" to all ally characters. "Deck Cut": After an ally target uses an attack, consumes all "Deck Cut," each stack of "Deck Cut" consumed advances this unit's action by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, and causes the attack target's "<u>Murmur</u>" to deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG × the number of consumed stacks.
3104017.shortDesc: "<u>Dealer</u>'s" Hits Per Action increases. Each time they deal DMG, grants 1 stack of "Deck Cut" to all ally characters: After an ally target uses an attack, consumes all "Deck Cut" stacks to trigger "<u>Murmur</u>" DMG on the enemy target, and advances their action.
3104017.lore:
Who in the world gave me this name? First of all, I do not have a big nose! And second, I have only existed for a decade since my creation. This nickname is dreadfully rude to a lady.
If you wish to speak of my name, has the peerless wind that startles heaven and earth ever dazzled your eyes? This is a skill that even Lady Graphia and that fox could not help but marvel at. My feathers once fell like a storm, tearing down the tower of the demons. My breath once stirred up raging waves, extinguishing the flames of calamity that rose on all sides. When I spread my wings, even the moon would shrink away. Yet these wings I once took such pride in can only barely shield you from the falling stars of the Demon Lord.
Do not be afraid, child. Let this moment be etched into your eyes, for these remaining wings will summon one final wind.

3104018.name: Wild Hunt Corp
3104018.description: Every time an ally target cumulatively reduces one enemy target's Toughness by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>, that enemy target gains 1 stack of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>." The actual Toughness Reduction taken while in the Weakness Broken state will also be taken into account. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>" cumulatively inflicted on all enemy targets, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Wind <u>base DMG</u> to all enemies.
3104018.shortDesc: For every set amount of Toughness reduced by ally targets, enemy targets gain "<u>Reverse Critical Boost</u>." After accumulating a certain number of stacks, deals Wind DMG to all enemies.
3104018.lore:
Tuna, you grabbed the wrong horn. In a vacuum, you're supposed to use the one that transmits electromagnetic waves. I can see it, the guidance left by the Lord of Everlasting Joy is right here. Listen closely: the ripples of cosmic dust. The evil that plagues this nebula is about to descend from the direction of the nine celestial stars.
The stars have turned ten times, and a new hunt is about to begin. Who will claim the first strike this time? Who will take down the monster's head and claim the highest honor of our kind as reward? Why, me, of course. I'll carve its skull into a finer weapon. Don't worry, Tuna. I'll save the best piece of meat for you... Alright, alright, you can share the family's spoils with your friends.
Sound the horn! Let it be known: We are not mere mad beasts enlightened by Yaoshi's whim, nor are we slaves to The Blemished One. We are warriors whom none can stand against. We are the houyhnhnm!

3104019.name: Captain Fury
3104019.description: "Magnetic Storm" appears on the Action Order: Each time it takes action, absorbs the Shields of all ally targets down to 1, converts them into this unit's Shield value, with the Shield value gained each time being no lower than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the sum of all ally targets' Max HP, and Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. When an ally target takes DMG, the Shield value of "Magnetic Storm" is consumed first, and when dealing "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG, <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Shield value of "Magnetic Storm" is additionally taken into account.
3104019.shortDesc: "Magnetic Storm" appears on the Action Order: When taking action each time, absorbs all ally targets' Shields and converts them into this unit's Shield value, and Charges "<u>Brain in a Vat</u>." When an ally target takes DMG, the Shield value of "Magnetic Storm" is consumed first, and when dealing "<u>Blazar</u>" DMG, the Shield value of "Magnetic Storm" is additionally taken into account.
3104019.lore:
Have you ever witnessed true heat waves? Metal screams as it vaporizes, billowing into thick clouds. Condensed particles fall alongside acid rain, a downpour of fury. Yet this is not a wasteland. It is the crucible where wisdom is born, a world that belongs to us alone. To me, your so-called flames are no more than a light drizzle.
Before you die, allow me to offer you a brief lesson, for I, too, was once a teacher. Heat arises from the motion and interaction of matter. When you learn to orchestrate their relationships, you can turn solid rock into a searing sea of lava, and command a rain of fire to condense into thousands of great ships sailing through it.
Rejoice, you hounds of the demon, for you shall bear witness to the finest spectacle of your lives.

3104020.name: Gloaming Grand Theater
3104020.description: "<u>Dealer</u>": Every point of Charge increases ally targets' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. When entering and exiting "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>", immediately triggers "<u>Dealer</u>" 1 time and additionally gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Charge. This instance of DMG can receive the True DMG boost from "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>".
3104020.shortDesc: "<u>Dealer</u>": Every point of Charge increases ally targets' CRIT DMG. When entering and exiting "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>," immediately triggers "<u>Dealer</u>" 1 time and additionally gains Charge. This instance of DMG can receive the boost from "<u>Butterfly Soul</u>."
3104020.lore:
I am the Gloaming Grand Theater, the oldest haunted house in Planarcadia. For several Amber Eras, no weapon, however mighty, has ever so much as cracked a single brick of my walls.
There was once a comedian who knew full well that his partner had been poisoned by a villain, but chose to said nothing, lest it spoil the perfection of the performance. His partner died on that very stage, and the show became the greatest comedic spectacle of the Cindearth Age. When the lights go up and the night falls, whatever takes the stage, the audience will roar with laughter. Even after they leave this place, the laughter will keep spreading, until it chokes the very breath from them.
That will suffice for introductions. You've waited long enough, my dear audience. Welcome to the Gloaming Grand Theater. The performance is about to begin. Please turn off all electronic devices, and remain seated.
Now, time to laugh.

3104021.name: Imaginator
3104021.description: Each stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" additionally increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s) recovered by allies, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Ice <u>base DMG</u> to all enemies.
3104021.shortDesc: Each stack of "<u>Obsession</u>" additionally increases CRIT DMG. After allies cumulatively recover a certain number of Skill Points, deals Ice DMG to all enemies.
3104021.lore:
Remember that unfinished sketch on the back of your high school homework? The one with the absurd limbs and the face made from an ink splatter? The tragedy you scribbled in the margin became its backstory. They came to me seeking freedom, and I granted them their wildest fancies.
That handsome fellow with no limbs? A speed-drawing exercise from the artist academy. Little Red Wolf and Big Grey Wolf? Summer homework from the elementary school next door. The boss with the impossibly long neck? A corporate worker's pent-up frustration. The girl with only a face? Someone's secret crush. And that knight, glowing from head to toe? Perhaps a child's childhood dream.
You'd better run. If you get caught... who knows what will happen next.

3104022.name: Banned Word Hunter
3104022.description: Increases ally characters' ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>. After every use of Ultimate or other abilities outside of this unit's turn, all ally characters gain <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "Popularity": When possessing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> or more stack(s) of "Popularity," after being attacked, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "Popularity" and deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of Additional DMG of a random Type equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of ATK to the attack target. This DMG cannot defeat enemy targets.
3104022.shortDesc: Ally characters' ATK is increased. After using an Ultimate or using other abilities outside of this unit's own turn, all ally characters gain "Popularity": Upon being attacked, deals a random Type of Additional DMG to the target.
3104022.lore:
The boundary of language is the boundary of cognition. Chaos is born from words that grow unchecked. Without filthy vocabulary, where would evil find its soil? Where would madness take root? When I press this button, all knowledge of profanity will be expelled from the mind. And arcadia will return to what it was always meant to be!
Don't believe me? Go ahead and try to say it: What do you get when you ferment wheat? What's that stick that smokes when you light it on fire? What's left behind when a person loses their life? And here's the best part: From now on, the Antimatter Legion can only *******!

3105001.name: Bedtime Story
3105001.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Remembrance, dealing Ice DMG to all enemy targets with a high chance of Freezing them for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). After being attacked by memosprite while under this Freeze effect, additionally take True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP. Every time the enemy target is afflicted with this Freeze state, this DMG can be triggered a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).
3105001.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Ice DMG to all enemies with a high chance of Freezing them. After being attacked by a memosprite while under this Freeze state, additionally take True DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max HP.
3105001.lore:
You retrace the footsteps of days gone by, wandering through a forgotten world.
But alas, the memories of the arcadia are but blurry verses, devoid of any worth.
The moon recites a bedtime story without a hero, lulling you to sleep. You close your eyes and catch the stray whispers while drifting away.
In an age immemorial, Aha planted flowers within a desolate world.
Eight Mourning Actors gathered beneath an ancient tree to tell their strange tales.
An ancient game was devised, and people donned masks to dance.
The demon lord from beyond set the earth ablaze, while Graphia led the people into the canvas.
Then, countless echoes of laughter were buried within the canvas, until a power from beyond the sky tore it asunder.
The ancient story ends there. And then, here is your today.

3105002.name: Adorable Black Hole
3105002.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Nihility. Inflicts Burn, Shock, Bleed, and 2 stacks of Wind Shear to all enemy targets, lasting for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s). After being attacked by a character, the aforementioned DoTs immediately deal DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
3105002.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, inflicts Burn, Shock, Bleed, and Wind Shear on all enemies. After receiving a character's attack, the inflicted DoTs can be triggered.
3105002.lore:
Congratulations! You have sunk deeper and deeper into nihility, and the ever-increasing gravity has finally turned you into a tiny black hole! Please do not ask the theory by which it happens. Having tumbled into Ahatopia by mistake, you siphoned up a mask. This granted you sentience and a sense of self, and you began to think that you were really, really adorable.
Were that not the case, why would everyone be looking at you? Not just their gazes, even light itself is drawn to you. "Gravity" has been warped by Elation, making it impossible for people to look away. They, too, must admit that you are really, really adorable. Immense Wishpower filled you with joy. In just a few more minutes, victory would be yours. And then, you evaporated.
Yes, do not forget that you are but a black hole.

3105003.name: Last Bullet
3105003.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of The Hunt, dealing Wind DMG to all enemy targets and advances all allies' actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, with the Max Energy being <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
3105003.shortDesc: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of The Hunt, dealing Wind DMG to all enemy targets and advances all allies' actions by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, with the Max Energy being <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
3105003.lore:
