Young one, you have reached the end of the line in both your Path and your reality. Hiding in the shadows, your wounds only sharpen your ragged breathing, making you all the more exposed. Who prowls through this city? Is it the slithering serpent, or the blood feud that slaughtered families? The maniac who summoned nightmares from the mirror? Or perhaps the Aberration shaped by everyone's fear...
Time seems to intersect at this moment. Between what has happened and what has yet to occur, your gaze finds a straight trail cutting through them all, connecting countless dots into a single line. Is this a quest for vengeance, blood for blood? Or is it justice sought for another? Staring at the blurry figure approaching, you have already cast aside the reason you came here.
You take a deep breath and align your barrel with the long stretch of time. Then, you fire the destined bullet.

3105004.name: Demon Lord From Beyond
3105004.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Destruction, dealing Fire DMG to all enemy targets, consumes all allies' HP until <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>, and increases all ally targets' Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the start of the turn, restore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the acting unit's consumed HP. This effect lasts for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> turn(s).
3105004.shortDesc: Upon triggering Boundary Equation, deals Fire DMG to all enemies, reduces all allies' HP, increases all allies' Max HP, restores all allies' HP at the beginning of the turn.
3105004.lore:
Hold up there, friend. Your destructive impulses have reached the system cap. Never before has a Supplicant walked so far down the Path of Destruction. Keep this up, even the legendary demon lord from beyond might feel humbled, though it once took eight Supplicants working together just to face him. Not that I can stop you, of course. So before you wander down that road of no return, let us chat about the story of that great villain?
Every hero story needs a cunning and wicked devil, right? Long, long ago, there was someone who commanded monsters and nearly reduced Ahatopia to cinders. In his hands, civilizations were like marbles in a pinball machine. One flick of his finger, they would tumble into abyss, leaving wails in their wake and not a single smile in sight. But just like every fairy tale, a hero came along and shattered his schemes. So...
<size=36>Wanna play a round?</size>

3105005.name: Infinite Improbability
3105005.description: Consumes <unbreak>100</unbreak> Energy to use an ability and trigger Boundary Resonance with the Path of Elation, dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>–<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> instances of Elation DMG of random Type(s) to all enemy targets, as well as immediately granting Aha 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Punchline points are taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchlines.
3105005.shortDesc: Consumes <unbreak>100</unbreak> Energy to use an ability and trigger Boundary Resonance with the Path of Elation, dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>–<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> instances of Elation DMG of random Type(s) to all enemy targets, as well as immediately granting Aha 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Punchline points are taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchlines.
3105005.lore:
Congratulations, your Elation *&&*&*@ has triggered a rejection reaction within the spacetime structure. Infinite Improbability phenomena are about to occur. Please be ready to *&*&&&& welcome it! Applaud! Spin around three times and jump!
A monkey monkey monkey is playing the Sixth Waltz of The Laughter on the back of a metal elephant, but it instantly transforms into a rain of screaming candy. The candy hits the ground and begins to burn. A circus emerges from the flames, only to be flattened by the toothbrush of a giant.
The mirror reflects eyes from the following night, then a tide of kaleidoscopic colors comes flooding out. A massive ship carries a parade of frenzied animals, and all things gain life within this moment. The deck opens its eyes to speak:
"Infinite Improbability phenomena have temporarily concluded. We hope you had fun."

3105006.name: Imagenated Creation
3105006.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use this ability and trigger Boundary Resonance with the Path of Propagation. Causes one designated ally to immediately take action and recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s). Gains the "<u>Levitation</u>" effect. When any enemy unit is defeated by a character with "<u>Levitation</u>," Boundary Equation regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> Energy, with the Max Energy set at <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
3105006.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, causes one designated ally to immediately take action, recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s), and gains "<u>Levitation</u>." When any enemy unit is defeated by a character that has "<u>Levitation</u>," Boundary Equation regenerates Energy, with the Max Energy set at <unbreak>200</unbreak>.
3105006.lore:
Desire... The desire to break free from your shell. Countless wishes urge your birth. Abundant Wishpower envelops your body, while the whirring of mechanical arms rises and falls in waves. You feel a surge of discomfort. Your formless, chaotic consciousness ceases its struggle. Like liquid poured into a vessel, your outline becomes anchored, your self gains shape, and savagery is washed away by humanity.
You open your eyes. In an instant, instinct grants you memories, survival skills and impulses. There is also a yearning to achieve, a hunger to pursue. Live on, as all living things do. Then spend your entire existence filling the void deep within your heart.
*Hypothesis: Studying the birth and behavioral patterns of imagenae in relation to Wishpower may assist current research on the Phantasmoon Games.*

3105007.name: References
3105007.description: Spend <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Erudition. Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all enemy targets. Additionally, links the enemy with the highest Max HP with other enemies, inflicting "<u>Central Link</u>" on all enemies, and regenerating Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Max Energy to all allies.
3105007.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies and inflicts the "<u>Central Link</u>" effect on them, regenerating Energy for all allies.
3105007.lore: Friend, you might have expected to find an equation here, but I am afraid you have simply stumbled into the database of the Divergent Universe. This is the underlying logic of the world. The entire *Arcadian Chronicles* is built upon the astronomical data here, used to construct numerous Supplicants and simulate data for various games and ceremonies across the universe. Of course, if you find yourself with a moment of leisure, feel free to flip through them at your convenience. References: *The Complete Collection of Phantasmoon Games (12th Edition)* *Chronicles of the Supplicants* *Legends of the Phantasmoon* *Studies on the Cindearth Age* *Arcadia in a Blink: The Evolution and Transformation of Phantasmoon Games Before the Canvas Age* ... *The Universal Encyclopedia of Games* *Ceremony, Games, and Modern Civilization* *Aeonic Faith and Regional Customs* *The Fundamental Principles of Wishpower* *99,999 Games You Never Knew Existed* *Planetary-Scale Games and Their Possible Connection to the Path of Elation* ...

3105008.name: Blissmost Gala
3105008.description: Spends <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Energy to use the ability and achieve Boundary Resonance with the Path of Harmony, dealing Quantum DMG to all enemy targets and Break their Weaknesses at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Break Effect. When Weakness is Broken, triggers all Weakness Break effects from all Types.
3105008.shortDesc: After triggering Boundary Equation, deals Quantum DMG to all enemy targets and Breaks their Weakness. Breaking Weakness triggers Weakness Break effects of all Types.
3105008.lore:
Get ready to rock! Who needs the Blissful Ball when we can make the world dance right here, right now? Electric guitar melodies pierce the night sky while the drums pound away. Your consciousness flows into the music, and your limbs leap to the rhythm of their own accord.
Happiness spreads like a contagion. You are dance partners, kindred spirits, and streaks of shimmering light drifting gracefully through the dance. You stand at the center of the stage to answer the cheers of the crowd, fire flickering upon your strings. Come now, come! Offer a boisterous performance to the arcadia. Let the thoughts of so many people be linked by rock and roll. Let the joy of them gather beneath the moon. Forget your worries and your sorrows. We shall all become one at last.
It has nothing to do with winning or losing the game. Tonight, we revel until the break of dawn!
